- The inner path is normalized to `/`, strips empty and `.` segments, rejects `..`, and rejects directory targets ending in `/`.
- Rewrites the whole archive through a temporary file and rename after replacing one entry.
- Creates the parent directory for the archive file if needed.

Example:

```text
path: "build/assets.tar.gz:css/app.css"
content: "body { color: black; }\n"
```

##### SQLite table insert

- Selector syntax: `db.sqlite:table`.
- `content` must parse as a JSON5 object.
- Empty object is allowed and becomes `INSERT INTO <table> DEFAULT VALUES`.
- Query parameters are rejected for SQLite writes.

Example:

```text
path: "data/app.db:users"
content: "{name: 'Ada', active: true}"
```

##### SQLite row update / delete

- Selector syntax: `db.sqlite:table:key`.
- Non-empty `content` updates the row.
- Empty or whitespace-only `content` deletes the row.
- Row lookup uses a single-column primary key when present, including on `WITHOUT ROWID` tables. Otherwise it falls back to `rowid`. Composite primary keys and unavailable rowid fallbacks are rejected.

Example update:

```text
path: "data/app.sqlite:users:42"
content: "{email: 'ada@example.com'}"
```

Example delete:

```text
path: "data/app.sqlite:users:42"
content: ""
```

##### Writable internal resources and tool devices

- `agent://<id>` with non-empty `content` sends a message to that peer (delivery receipt text); `agent://all` broadcasts to visible live peers; only the main agent may broadcast, and a subagent's `agent://all` write fails with an error naming direct messages instead. This write is read-approved and allowed in plan mode and `deviceOnlyWrite` when messaging is available. `agent://` reads remain output artifacts.
- `agent://<id>?progress` marks the message as an acknowledgement or progress note on something that peer asked: it answers nothing and asks nothing, so the peer's `wait` keeps blocking for the real reply, which is any later plain message. It wakes no relay turn. `agent://all?progress` is rejected.
- `proc://<id>` sends `content` to service stdin (Enter appended unless already newline-terminated); empty content sends Enter, never cancels. `write({ path: "proc://<id>/kill" })` cancels a job or owned subagent, or stops a service; `content` is optional and ignored. `proc://<id>/mode` requires `content` of `persist` or `session` to toggle persistence, or `detached` to restart without a PTY and persist beyond the broker. Proc writes require exec approval. Stdin and `/mode` writes are blocked in plan mode and unavailable in `deviceOnlyWrite` sessions; `/kill` is allowed in both. Proc reads do not consume job delivery. `/kill` and `/mode` are write-only.
- `out://` shows `content` (Markdown, at most 64 KiB) to the user as a reply without ending the turn: the transcript draws the call as assistant prose that streams with the arguments, not as a tool card, and keeps it visible when tool activity is hidden. The URL path is ignored and the scheme is write-only. The write is read-approved and allowed in plan mode and `deviceOnlyWrite`. It is refused for subagents, and where `out.enabled` is off — by default everywhere but the interactive TUI (terminal or Tern), so print, RPC, and ACP sessions neither see nor accept it unless `out.enabled` is explicitly set. Only sessions where it is on get the system-prompt entry.
- A registered internal handler with a `write` hook owns its resource semantics (for example, `cfg://`, `agent://`, `proc://`). File-backed schemes (`local://`, `vault://`) have no hook: the router locates the target file (`local://` in the session-local artifact sandbox, `vault://` under the vault root) and the write follows the plain-file path.
- `xd://` lists/dispatches tool devices mounted behind `write`. Read `xd://<name>` first, then pass one JSON object as `content`. Device schema, updates, result blocks, error flag, renderer metadata, and approval tier are preserved. The outer approval gate uses `tools.approval.<device>` before the generic `write` policy.
- Unknown URI-like schemes are refused to prevent silent local-file creation. Use `./scheme://...` only when that filename is intentional.
- Registered read-only schemes (no write policy: `artifact://`, `skill://`, `history://`, …) are denied at the approval gate (`<scheme>:// URLs are read-only`) without prompting; `edit` and `ast_edit` targets are denied the same way. A trailing line selector on a write, edit, or bash URL target (`local://notes.md:5`) is refused rather than dropped; only `:raw`/`:conflicts` are peeled.

##### Merge-conflict resolution

- Read `<file>:conflicts` (or a read window surfacing markers) to register session-stable ids. `conflict://<N>` replaces only that recorded marker block and revalidates it against the file. Copied adjacent context is trimmed when it would duplicate lines outside the block, with a receipt note.
- Before acting, `conflict://<N>` re-checks its file's registered ids against the live marker blocks (`conflict://*` re-checks every registered file). Unchanged blocks keep their ids across line shifts; changed or vanished blocks (aborted merge, reset, external resolution, deleted file) are retired, and a different block at the same line gets a fresh id. The check streams the file with memory bounded by the largest registered block, so it also covers blocks past the discovery byte cap. A `:conflicts` read retires its file's stale ids, except past a capped scan.
- A line exactly equal to `@ours`, `@theirs`, `@base`, or `@both` expands to the recorded side (`@both` is ours then theirs). `@base` requires a diff3 base. Other content is literal.
- `conflict://*` with ordinary content applies the same replacement/token expansion to every registered conflict. Per-id directive content such as `1: @ours\n2: @theirs` resolves only the listed ids; every non-empty directive line must use one side token and ids may not repeat.
- Bulk processing is all-or-nothing per file, applied bottom-up. Other files can still succeed; partial cross-file success returns `isError: true`, while an all-failed pass throws. Successful ids are invalidated and failed-file ids remain registered for retry.
- Conflict writes bypass LSP formatting/diagnostics while markers remain; distinct identical blocks remain separately addressable.
- `/ours`, `/theirs`, and `/base` URI scopes are read-only. Read line selectors do not change the write directive grammar.

#### Side Effects

- Filesystem
   - Creates or overwrites plain files.
   - Rewrites entire archive files atomically through a temporary sibling and rename when writing an entry.
   - Explicitly creates parent directories for archive files; the plain-file backend also supports missing parents.
   - Mutates existing SQLite databases; never creates a new SQLite DB.
   - Resolves conflict markers in files for `conflict://...` writes.
   - May chmod a shebang file executable after a successful plain-file write.
- Subprocesses / native bindings
   - Uses Bun SQLite bindings via `bun:sqlite`.
   - Uses the unified archive utilities in `packages/utils/src/ar`: tar serialization plus gzip/zstd framing for compressed tars, `node:zlib`-backed DEFLATE framing for ZIP, and an ASAR encoder.
   - May talk to configured LSP servers through `packages/coding-agent/src/lsp/index.ts`.
- Session state
   - Enforces plan-mode write restrictions before mutating the target.
   - Updates file mutation/snapshot state for plain files and conflict resolutions; resolved conflict ids are invalidated.
   - `xd://` dispatches a mounted tool and may therefore have that tool's documented side effects.
- Background work / cancellation
   - Marks the tool `concurrency = "exclusive"` in `WriteTool`.
   - The write body is wrapped with `untilAborted`; LSP writethrough can schedule deferred diagnostics fetches after a timeout.

#### Limits & Caps

- Plain/internal file content has no tool-level byte cap beyond in-memory handling. Archive readers default to `256 MiB` in-memory input and `64 MiB` per member. ZIP output emits ZIP64 records for large entry counts, but member sizes and central-directory/member offsets remain below the 32-bit sentinel.
- The generated-file guard delegates to `editAutoGeneratedMessage` in `crates/pi-natives/src/edit.rs`, reading at most `1024` bytes; `crates/pi-edit/src/path_policy.rs` checks at most `40` header lines. `edit.blockAutoGenerated` controls the guard.
- SQLite writes set `PRAGMA busy_timeout = 3000`.
- LSP writethrough (`packages/coding-agent/src/lsp/writethrough.ts`) uses a `5_000` ms operation timeout in `runLspWritethrough()` and may schedule deferred diagnostics with `AbortSignal.timeout(25_000)`.
- Shebang executable handling depends on host filesystem chmod support.

#### Errors

- Invalid archive subpaths throw `ToolError` with messages such as:
   - `Archive write path must target a file inside the archive`
   - `Archive write path must target a file, not a directory`
   - `Archive path cannot contain '..'`
- SQLite path parsing throws on unsupported forms:
   - `SQLite write paths do not support query parameters`
   - `SQLite write path must target a table`
   - `SQLite row writes require a non-empty row key`
- Missing SQLite DBs surface as `SQLite database '<path>' not found`.
- SQLite content errors include invalid JSON5, non-object payloads, unknown columns, non-scalar values, empty update objects, composite primary keys, and unavailable rowid fallbacks. Read-style `?where=` selectors are not a write workaround.
- Existing plain files may be rejected by `assertEditableFile()` when they look generated.
- Existing plain-file targets and SQLite database candidates that are neither regular files nor directories are refused with `Cannot write '<path>': it is a <kind>, not a regular file or directory.` Opening or reading them in-process can block forever (a FIFO with no writer, a terminal).
- A file-backed URL write whose target is an existing directory fails with `<scheme>:// URL must resolve to a file: <url>`.
- URI-like unknown targets and malformed/missing `xd://` devices fail rather than writing local files; mounted devices surface their own schema/tool errors.
- Empty writes to missing selector-shaped targets and semicolon-joined selector lists are rejected as likely read/write mis-dispatches.
- Incomplete read projections that would discard unseen source are rejected; re-read omitted ranges and replace the whole file, or use `edit` for a partial change.
- Conflict scope writes are read-only; invalid/stale ids, malformed bulk directives, missing `@base`, and stale marker locations surface `ToolError`.
- Archive read/write failures and unexpected SQLite exceptions are wrapped in `ToolError(error.message)`.
- If no LSP server matches or LSP formatting/diagnostics times out, file writes still complete; diagnostics may be omitted.

#### Notes

- Archive path detection runs before SQLite detection. A path that matches an archive selector is never treated as SQLite.
- SQLite detection declines when an existing file with a `.sqlite` / `.db` suffix lacks SQLite magic bytes; the path falls back to a plain file write.
- Archive rewriting uses the unified `readArchiveEntries()` / `writeArchive()` boundary and a temp-file rename. String members are encoded as UTF-8.
- For an existing archive symlink, the writer infers format from the resolved target's suffix, falling back to uncompressed tar when that suffix is unknown; the selector's suffix does not override this.
- The prompt forbids two common anti-patterns: using `write` for routine edits that should use `edit`, and creating `*.md` / `README` files unless explicitly requested. It also forbids emojis unless requested.
- Generic write receipts count UTF-8 bytes with `Buffer.byteLength(...)`; handler-owned receipts define their own content/status wording.
- `stripWriteContent()` only removes hashline prefixes when the session’s file display mode has `hashLines` enabled; otherwise content is written unchanged. Even then it removes them only when every content row carries one and each number is one more than the row above, except after a blank, elision or header row (how `read` and `grep` number their rows); numbers that jump, such as hex dump addresses or log timestamps, stay as written, and so do partial views that skip rows without a marker (edit previews, `ast_grep` matches). `conflict://*` per-id directives are recognized behind a copied `LINE:` prefix either way.

- The tool has `strict = true`, `loadMode = "essential"`, and exclusive concurrency. The native transcript view previews the first 8 content lines; `xd://` results delegate rendering to the mounted device.

### Browser, desktop, speech and automatic memory removal

This report covers the removal integrated after `c3b3c3dd12`, the documented
Sharpshooter-only baseline. The downstream is the public repository
`NexusKMT/omp-slim`, based on upstream v18.18.3. Earlier successful Linux and
Intel Mac builds do not establish that this larger removal builds correctly.

#### Product boundary

| Removed | Retained behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Built-in browser tool/preludes, Chromium/Puppeteer, Chrome installer, tab workers, relay backend and browser extension | HTTP search/fetch, normal system URL opening, external MCP, Tern terminal `/fork` |
| Browser PDF page screenshots, browser search fallbacks, cookie-capture sign-in | Native PDF text/page extraction including archives; external OCR guidance for scans; normal OAuth/API-key and email OTP/TOTP |
| Native desktop capture, accessibility, application/window control and input on macOS/Linux/Windows; `computer` worker/tool/prelude/command | Clipboard, shell/PTY, user-wait coordination, image processing, power management, ordinary terminal recording |
| Microphone capture, dictation, TTS, live voice, speech setup/downloaders, `say`, `tts`, `/live`, voice extension/RPC/ACP surfaces and `pi-voice` | Text input, paste/undo/Vim, terminal bell, ordinary model authentication and generic provider/catalog protocol types |
| Local summaries, Hindsight, Mnemopi, Sharpshooter residue, automatic learning/extraction/injection, memory tools/commands/URL scheme, `packages/mnemopi`, dedicated native vector kernels | Session storage/history/resume/fork, context compaction, explicit `manage_skill`, manual AGENTS/SKILL files and skill discovery |

Codex attestation was moved unchanged from `live/attestation.ts` to
`config/codex-attestation.ts`; ordinary Codex requests still need it.
Larger local tiny models remain available for completion/judgment. Their
former memory-specific grouping was renamed to describe those retained uses.
Generic model/provider computer-call and audio wire types remain for SDK and
history compatibility. `ttsr` and native heap `memory.rs` are unrelated and remain.

Old browser, desktop and memory configuration keys are retired during normal
configuration migration. Existing user data files are not deleted. Old speech
keys remain inert and cannot restore a deleted tool. Manual skill discovery
continues to read previously managed skills.

#### Source and dependency changes

Four isolated worktrees handled the feature removals. The user capped
concurrency at five agents including the coordinator; existing workers were
reused for integration reviews and could not spawn further workers.

The integrated source at `d7f1646f90182a27353b8c38455e2d1c4a892f15`
changes 1,051 files with 3,988 additions and 245,196 deletions relative to
`c3b3c3dd12`, a net reduction of 241,208 lines. These counts include
implementation, dedicated tests, generated schemas, lockfiles and
documentation; they are not a binary-size measurement.

| Lockfile metric | Before | After |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Cargo package entries | 979 | 799 |
| Bun package entries | 462 | 396 |
| Bun workspace entries, including the root | 18 | 16 |

`cargo update --workspace` removed unused entries while preserving all retained
package versions: 180 removals and no additions. Bun resolution likewise added
no package entries. `bun run gen:nix` regenerated the Nix dependency expression,
and the frozen Bun installation check passed. The Bazel derived lock must also
match the final Cargo graph. Both `gen:bazel-lock` and a subsequent `--check`
passed, including a check after removing the temporary download mirror used
to work around slow downloads. The generated repository count fell from 962
to 783, with 179 removals and no additions; the lock shrank from 4,009,531 to
3,279,903 bytes. A stale `ring` annotation was removed. The resulting lock
contains no local paths or mirror URLs.

Native third-party notices were conservatively pruned only for crate names
entirely absent from the final lock. This removed 224 records and 88 empty
license blocks, preserving 779 records and every corresponding license text
byte. Removed Opus and inferno notices were also dropped; retained obligations
such as uluru, PCRE2 and vendored sources remain. An independent multiset
comparison checked each retained record and license-body SHA-256. Existing
upstream version drift in notices, including libc/jiff/zip, was preserved;
this is not a full cargo-about regeneration or a license coverage audit.

The changed HTML viewer is now embedded in compiled and npm CLI builds and
included as a packaged text asset for SDK imports. Exports inline that viewer
instead of requesting the downstream hash from upstream's CDN. The existing
fixed marked/highlight resources remain external. Forty-seven relevant tests
passed, including a real compiled probe, npm packing, SDK/source parity and
execution of the generated inline viewer. This adds roughly 769 KiB to each
exported HTML document.

#### Validation

The merged tree passed the full `bun run check:ts` command: lint, formatting and
all workspace type checks. Fourteen existing lint warnings remain; there were
no lint or type errors. Rust formatting passed with the pinned
`nightly-2026-11-08` formatter. Workflow syntax passed actionlint 1.7.12.

Feature workers exercised migration and stored-data preservation, session
resume/fork/compaction, manual skills, HTTP/PDF/MCP/Tern behavior, clipboard,
TUI editing, RPC schemas and the affected Python SDK. Their focused runs used
the baseline native addon for retained functionality; those runs cannot prove
that the rebuilt addon has removed all retired symbols.

One combined SDK suite exposed shared settings contamination: a shell test
initialized global settings, and a shared ModelRegistry without explicit
settings then adopted the user's disabled-provider list. The fixture now uses
isolated settings, in-memory authentication and a temporary model path.
Reproduction with a synthetic globally disabled OpenAI provider passed all
57 tests / 253 assertions after the fix, with two loopback requests and zero
external network attempts. This does not replace the full retained CI suite.

The advisor fix keeps recorder feeds detached until the existing mode
transition completes, preserving old-session costs while excluding late
events from the new branch. The ACP fix checks the captured prompt identity
and settled state after asynchronous waits, so an old end handler cannot
drain late results or finish a newer request. Its deterministic regression
fails against the earlier implementation and passes after the fix. The SDK
timeout fixture now tests recovery in a separate lifecycle emission with the
normal budget, using a fake timer only for the intentionally stalled call.
Shell-state fixtures await the individual job's final result and use an
explicit release marker to establish overlap. The complete affected ACP,
async-delivery and SDK files passed 190 tests with 838 assertions in isolated
processes/configuration. The merged workspace also passed `check:ts` locally
with the newly built native addon.

The full suite exposed a
previously passing native PTY test intermittently receiving no complete JSON
output from a fast-exiting child.

The PTY implementation and original test were unchanged from the baseline.
Concurrent reproduction confirmed output loss even with awaited or synchronous
child writes, so changing the fixture's write API would not fix the issue.
A minimal system-PTY probe showed that macOS can discard unread output when
the last slave descriptor closes. The existing `pi-shell` zpty implementation
already accounts for that behavior. The native PTY fix now retains that
descriptor until the reader accepts the available bytes. A bounded progress
notification wakes the wait; cancellation, timeout, reader disconnect and
failed readiness queries can all terminate it. The existing JS/backpressure
drain still delivers bytes already read. Three deterministic Unix regressions
and a concurrent fast-exit JS regression cover the change. Independent review
found no blocking issue. The later Mac build passed the native regressions and
120 local concurrent output probes with the rebuilt addon, as recorded below.

The grammar failure was reproduced with an empty cache and an unavailable
download endpoint. Both the AST search alias test and the related `.tla`
editing test now parse the pinned official grammar in isolated child
processes. Its compressed fixture is 123,099 bytes, accompanied by the MIT
license and provenance; decompressed size/hash must match the native
manifest. The same ten-file CI group passed 275 tests / 1,145 assertions
offline, preserving real matching, preview and file-write checks.

#### Maintaining the downstream

The upstream baseline remains pinned. Integrate selected upstream fixes and
review shared registration/lifecycle files carefully: CLI dispatch, SDK,
AgentSession, settings/tool registries, native exports and build manifests were
touched by several removals. A future upstream merge can otherwise restore a
retired capability or a dependency without recreating its whole directory.

The retained CLI updater still targets upstream's build service. Automatic
updates default to false; keep `update.auto` false for this fork and disable
`startup.checkUpdate` notices in its profile. Use this repository's build
artifacts to update the downstream. A fork-specific update service was not
part of the four feature removals, and existing user settings were not changed.

Dependency changes require Bun/Cargo lock updates and regeneration of both
Nix and Bazel metadata. RPC changes require `gen:rpc`; export renderer changes
require `gen:export-viewer --write` and the packaged-export tests. The native
build now checks the actual addon for retired exports while checking that
clipboard, shell and PDF entry points remain present.

The retained AST/grammar, Git/Jujutsu, PDF/image and local inference components
still require a substantial Rust toolchain. Source deletion and fewer locked
packages do not imply a proportionate reduction in compilation time. Public
manual Actions keep validation under explicit control; cache and artifact
timings above provide the measured basis for future maintenance estimates.

The added macOS PTY check currently uses Cargo's implicit host target, while
N-API passes an explicit target triple. Those builds use different target
layouts despite sharing the `ci` profile and parent cache directory. Aligning
the target selection is a candidate for reducing duplicate compilation;
its benefit has not been measured. The first PTY check compiled for 27m08s
and executed its ten tests in 3.359s. The resulting combined cache was
1,846,845,729 bytes.

### 裁剪审计报告（2026-11-12）

审计方法：全仓 LOC 普查（TS/Rust，排除 node_modules/dist/target）+ 3 个只读侦察任务（死导出/设置键、web 面、Rust 面）+ 逐项消费者验证。审计于 2026-11-12 上午完成；同日下午按第二节逐项执行删除并完成测试对账。

#### 一、当前规模快照

TypeScript（13 包）：src 2,153 文件 / 758K 行；测试 2,428 文件 / 620K 行。

| 包 | src 行 | 测试行 | 备注 |
|---|---|---|---|
| coding-agent | 436.9K | 447.2K | 最大单体：agent-session.ts 13.6K、interactive-mode.ts 9.2K |
| tui | 192.7K | 90.7K | |
| utils | 38.9K | 16.9K | |
| ai | 18.7K | 16.7K | 传输已收缩到 providers/openai-completions.ts 等 1.7K |
| agent | 16.5K | 20.0K | |

### Single-model OMP Slim

This downstream uses one selected main chat model. Configure it directly:

```yaml
model: provider/model-id
```

`--model` and `/model` still select the main model manually. Planning, approval
and execution retain that selection and its thinking level. There is no plan
model to assign. Subagents inherit the exact parent model at launch and revival,
including endpoint and routing metadata. Already-running child sessions retain
their launch model until their normal lifecycle ends; a manual main-model change
does not rewrite an in-flight child's history. Personas, task instructions,
tool permissions, concurrency and thinking effort remain available.

Model roles, role cycles, presets, per-agent and per-call model overrides,
prewalk handoffs, context-window model promotion, retry fallback chains and
composer model mentions have been removed. Legacy `modelRoles.default` migrates
to `model` only when the same configuration layer has no explicit `model` value.
Other retired role settings cannot reactivate routing. Historical session model
entries and model tags remain readable.

Advisors, Vibe, Autoresearch and built-in personality presets are removed.
Titles, job widgets,
skill-description compression, enabled edit repair, explicit judgments and
image questions use the current model object. Failed requests do not select a
second model. Title generation offers a fork or a separate request to this
same model; legacy `title.generator: tiny` migrates to `request`. Automatic
title-drift and unexpected-stop classification requests are removed. Mechanical
recovery of empty or thinking-only replies remains, alongside same-model retries,
credential rotation, bounded quota waits and context compaction. An unavailable
saved session model reports an error; an explicit user model choice remains possible. A text-only model preserves
image attachments and reports its capability limit instead of calling another
vision model.

The independent tiny/MLX/ONNX inference installers and workers, predictive
composer runtime, automatic judge routing, Spotlight ranking/output rewriting
and the image-generation product tool are removed. Later trims also removed
native prediction, Apple Foundation Models, the bundled catalog, provider
authentication integrations and all transports except Chat Completions.

### Native build performance — 2026-11-17

The `ci` profile now keeps O3 and disables LTO. A warm addon-only compile
fell from 10m 03s to 2m 46s (72.5% shorter), and the isolated PTY regression
command takes 8s instead of the preceding 19m 14s. All three comparison jobs
and the complete Linux Rust validation passed.

The development goal is faster feedback after editing code. The source CLI and
focused crate commands now provide that path; the local measurements below are
separate from the remote full-build comparison.

#### Local development feedback

The working checkout now loads the verified O3/no-LTO native addon from run
`43947005367`, source `91e59623f58a23792c97c73f08d34d0d1acb08cd`.
Its SHA-256 is
`a99244e40901e09b3659befa708ae4c88b2cb10350dcd4e5c98f1c8c66efe327`.
The previous local addon still exposed removed APIs despite having the same
package version. It was backed up, replaced, and checked with
`scripts/slim/verify-native.ts`. The generated declarations were recovered with
the addon. Ordinary TypeScript edits can now use `bun run dev`, restarting the
source process after each edit, without compiling or packaging Rust.

The Rust task wrapper previously ignored extra arguments. It now accepts
`--package` / `-p` for `check:rs`, `lint:rs` and `test:rs`, plus `-E` /
`--filter-expr` for focused nextest runs. An explicit package runs regardless of
the branch-diff gate. Formatting, Clippy and doctests are restricted to the
selected packages; nextest filters leave those doctests enabled. Unknown
options and a test filter without a package fail before Cargo starts.

These are wall times measured on the local Intel Mac, including the command
wrapper. The source CLI used isolated configuration directories and made no
model requests. Rust commands used two build jobs and the same initially empty
`CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/omp-slim-rust-feedback-501`; only `pi-pty` and its small
dependency graph were compiled locally.

dropping the cancellation callback instead of calling it caused the existing

implementation recompiled the crate and passed both cancellation tests in
3.766s. Both source files were restored byte for byte; the probe changes are
not part of the implementation. Logs and source hashes are recorded alongside

The 2.966s cached filtered run had no intervening source edit; the edit probe
above did. Neither measures rebuilding the full addon after a Rust change.
The complete native graph still requires a remote build, and a new addon is
needed to observe native changes in the CLI. `--help` timing is also not an

Eight wrapper regression tests, script type checking, focused script lint and
formatting, and native-package type checking passed. Raw command logs, timing
JSON and the addon installation record are in
`dist/validation/dev-loop-2026-11-17/`. See
[OMP Slim](#development-feedback) for the everyday commands.

#### Implemented changes

The seven output-drain regression tests now compile `pi-pty`, a small crate
containing the implementation also called by the N-API PTY session. The drain
function body is unchanged. Its generic queue payload removes the dependency
on the addon's `ReaderEvent` type; cancellation, EOF, slow callbacks and
backpressure behavior remain covered by the original tests.

`test:rs:pty` now selects `pi-pty` and passes an explicit Cargo target, matching
napi's `CARGO_BUILD_TARGET` or the active Rust toolchain's host triple. Before
this change napi built under `<target>/<triple>/ci` while nextest used
`<target>/ci`. Matching the directory alone would still require a separate
large test executable, so extracting the tested implementation is the main
fix. Cargo's unit graph drops from 716 units for the implicit-target native
test executable to 8 for the explicit-target PTY test executable. Feature
unification can still cause some small dependencies to rebuild.

The normal macOS workflow also runs the existing `PtySession` integration
cases against the fresh addon: argv handling, process-start notification,
slow-consumer backpressure and detached-workload timeout. These validate the
binding and operating-system behavior in addition to the extracted queue
logic. The build message now prints the selected Cargo profile instead of
always saying `local`.

| Addon-only Cargo rebuild | 10m 03s | **2m 46s** | 2m 00s |
| Addon-only rebuild including bindings | 10m 06s | **2m 51s** | 2m 04s |
| PTY test compilation | 9.12s | **3.23s** | 2.37s |
| Seven PTY tests | 2.860s | 3.004s | 2.992s |
| Complete Rust PTY command | 13s | **8s** | 7s |
| Addon size | 94,403,344 bytes | 93,884,000 bytes | 93,151,904 bytes |
| CLI size | 194,367,856 bytes | 193,723,888 bytes | 193,509,232 bytes |
| Whole job including comparison rebuild and artifact upload | 44m 19s | 52m 10s | 45m 16s |

Every runner reported Intel i7-8700B, four exposed logical CPUs and 14 GiB RAM.
The first build emitted 57 Cargo timing units with ThinLTO versus 763 with LTO
off: the old cache did not match the new optimization settings. These first
build times therefore do not demonstrate a clean-build speedup. Cache restore
alone took 233s, 252s and 210s respectively. The extra addon rebuild exists
only in the optimization experiment, not in the normal build job.

Each second build emitted exactly one timing unit, `pi-natives`. Its durations
were 602.17s, 164.58s and 119.12s respectively. This provides direct evidence for
faster iteration after dependencies are available, though separate hosted
runners and a single sample per mode limit precision. Cargo does not split
this final unit into separate LLVM and linker durations; it would be incorrect
to label its entire duration as linking.

The first O3/no-LTO dependency path still spends substantial time in
`pi-builtins` (621.35s) and `pi-shell` (532.32s), plus shared libraries such as
`jj-lib` (386.72s). Those unit durations overlap. The patch removes repeated
large compilation for PTY tests and reduces addon rebuild cost; it does not
make a fresh native dependency build instantaneous.

The prior default/no-WASM run at `ce08acb110` spent 19m 02s compiling the large
PTY test executable and 19m 14s in the entire PTY command. With the new tiny
crate, even the unchanged ThinLTO configuration compiles it in 9.12s and finishes
the command in 13s. With the selected configuration the command takes 8s.

#### Default and limits

Only `ci` changes to `lto = "off"`; O3, 16 codegen units, unwind handling and
stripping remain. Cargo's resolved graph without environment overrides matches
the measured O3/no-LTO overrides. `release` and `local` keep their existing
optimization settings. O2 remains a comparison option: its additional compile
saving does not by itself justify reducing workspace optimization.

The existing N-API tokenizer probe was run against each recovered addon in
separate processes on the same Intel Mac, with 33 encoding/corpus combinations,
one second per case, and two rounds per addon. Every token count matched across
all modes. O3/no-LTO throughput averaged across the two rounds had a geometric
mean ratio of 1.33 relative to ThinLTO; O2/no-LTO was 0.97. However, individual
round ratios varied substantially (O3/no-LTO 1.56 and 1.17; O2/no-LTO 1.14 and
0.86), so these data do not establish a runtime speedup or performance parity
for the full application. The probe source, raw samples and summary are saved
with the build evidence. No local Rust compilation was used.

The source containing the two lint corrections passed the complete Rust gate.
The comparison artifacts use the earlier snapshot; their only Rust difference
from that validated implementation is the removed unused import and closure
semicolon. Later changes select the already-tested CI profile, improve the
build log, narrow the test filter, and document results. The full TypeScript
runtime suite was not rerun for this performance experiment.

All three GitHub artifact ZIP digests were checked, as were the nested CLI
archive and binary checksums. Logs, metrics, Cargo timing reports, unit graphs,
recovered binaries and a provenance manifest are under
`dist/validation/build-perf-2026-11-17/`.

### OMP Slim cleanup — 2026-11-17

This source cleanup follows the review of `99d54bf936` on `main`. At the time
of this report the changes are in the working tree, uncommitted and unpublished.
The diff removes approximately 62,000 net lines, including implementation,
dedicated tests, research code and obsolete documentation. This is a source
measurement; binary size must be measured after a fresh remote build.

#### Implementation corrections

- Removed upstream self-update from startup, workers, CLI/slash commands,
  settings, setup and the welcome screen. Removed its install/download and
  binary-delta paths. Retired update settings are discarded during migration.
  Plugin marketplace upgrades remain available.
- Reserved `omp update` and `omp ssh` now report explicit downstream guidance
  before launch, including when preceded by launch flags. Explicit `launch`
  and `--` still allow those words to be used as prompt text.
- Embedded native manifests include SHA-256 digests. Extraction replaces a
  cached addon whose bytes differ even if the version and size match, validates
  decompressed bytes before atomic publication, and checks fallback candidates
  against the embedded manifest before loading. Installed unversioned addons
  no longer pass merely because a few old core symbols exist. Validated bindings
  are reused inside a process so lazy clipboard calls do not rehash the addon.
- Root TypeScript checks now include build and maintenance scripts through
  `check:scripts`. Removed stale `gen:compat`, `gen:models`, metaharness and
  Claude trace entrypoints. The changelog rewriting script requires an explicit
  configured model and uses the model registry's credential resolution.
- Removed stale Go SDK `PredictWord` tests and corrected the remaining error
  variable declaration. Added `test:go` and a manual public SDK validation
  workflow for Go and Python contracts.

#### Further removals

- Product build and load targets are macOS Intel and Linux x64, with baseline
  and modern addon variants. ARM targets and the unsuffixed addon fallback are
  removed; the Linux musl release target is retained.
- Removed the unused Apple Foundation Models native bridge and HDiffPatch
  updater-only bindings. Native declarations and generated JS exports agree
  with the reduced source surface. The remote native verifier rejects those
  retired exports.
- Removed tracked metaharness files and Snapcompact research/benchmark files.
  The lockfile drops metaharness, vibemon, protobuf and connect dependencies
  without upgrading retained package versions.
- Removed built-in SSH host discovery, configuration, connection management,
  file transfer, `ssh://` routing, commands, prompts, public exports and their
  dedicated tests. Generic URL approval, authority-port and selector tests now
  register an explicit test protocol. They still check that a lower approval
  tier cannot invoke an exec-tier handler.
- Updated the main English/Chinese README, project guidance, model/provider
  and compaction documentation, CLI reference and affected tool/native docs.
  Historical build records remain identified as historical.

The retained scope includes sessions and resume, editing, shell/PTY execution,
subagents, MCP, HTTP search, manual instructions, local stats, RPC SDKs,
Snapcompact runtime and the native shell/builtin crates. Git SSH transport and
running the terminal application through an SSH session remain supported.

#### Completed validation

Local validation used Bun 1.4.4. No full native or standalone product build ran
locally for this cleanup.

| `bun run check:ts` | Passed: lint/format checks, root scripts and all workspace type checks. Existing lint warnings remain. |
| Final `check:tools` and `check:scripts` | Passed after the last script changes. |

| `bun run test:py` | 104 Python SDK tests passed. |

Focused TS coverage includes native extraction and identity checks, CPU target
selection, npm leaf generation, musl release planning, CLI routing/setup,
welcome rendering, settings migration, internal URL approval and selectors,
local read/write/search behavior, plugins, model registry, interrupted thinking
and HTTP search query handling. The native embed test that compiles a standalone

Validation logs are archived locally in
`dist/validation/cleanup-2026-11-17/` (ignored build evidence). The accompanying

### OMP Slim：编译原理与差分实验

目标：回答「修改哪里需要等待多久」「时间花在哪个编译阶段」「哪种加速真正生效」，并保存可复查的原始数据。

#### 结果与必须先纠正的实验条件

三组矩阵已完成：[Actions 44029960333](https://github.com/NexusKMT/omp-slim/actions/runs/44029960333)，源码 `3f755707f70a842c5cc188f4b45c23e27fb89a6f`。27 次真实修改、27 次新行为验证和 worker smoke 全部通过，三个修改点全部恢复，最后的原始行为与导出检查通过。每组完整作业耗时 46–50 分钟，包含预热、9 次编辑、3 次恢复和缓存传输；这不是一次编辑需要的时间。

**这批数据实际没有启用 rustc incremental。** 原始 `unit-graph.json` 的三个目标 crate 都是 `incremental: false`；矩阵保存的实际 rustc 命令也没有 `-C incremental=...`。固定工具链 `nightly-2026-11-08` 在 `CI` 存在时默认关闭 incremental，即使 profile 写了 `incremental=true`。同一工具链的无依赖微型工程复现了三个状态：无 CI → true；CI=true → false；CI=true 加 CARGO_INCREMENTAL=1 → true。[Cargo build.incremental](https://doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/reference/config.html#buildincremental)。

因此，本文所有已完成的远程数据应解释为 **保留依赖产物的真实编辑重编译**，不能解释为已开启 rustc 查询/代码生成复用的最终开发性能。早期进度中称它们为「增量开发实测」不准确。配置文件、缓存命中与真正传给编译器的选项必须分别检查。

已修正实验设施：两个开发测量 job 显式设置 `CARGO_INCREMENTAL=1`；正式构建前生成并检查 effective unit graph，任一目标 crate 未启用 incremental 就立即终止；新结果使用 `v2-inc1` 缓存键，同时允许复用旧依赖目录。这个检查已在无依赖三 crate 工程中验证了拒绝与通过两个分支，没有进行本地完整编译。**截至本报告 11 月 17 日写作时，修正后的 OMP 完整计时尚未重跑。**

11 月 20 日审核补记：11 月 18 日的 [44300999380](https://github.com/NexusKMT/omp-slim/actions/runs/44300999380) 已成功完成启用 incremental 的一次 native 编辑：构建安装 26.125s，行为验证及 worker smoke 完成 29.530s，原始行为恢复和最终测试通过。它使用旧的 `dev lto=false`；当前已改为 `"off"`。这条数据此前未写入本报告，不能再称“修正后从未实测”，也不能从一个样本推导当前 profile 的稳定加速倍数。证据和新一轮实测见 [2026-11-20 审核](#omp-slim-构建审核--2026-11-20)。

实验入口现在默认 `benchmark_scope=quick`：开发 profile 默认仅 dev，单个 native 改动；编译矩阵默认仅前端 1 线程、单个 native 改动。只有显式选择 `full` 才执行三次采样和全部矩阵。首次预热仍有成本。

#### 编译链与需要分别测量的时间

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A[源码改动] --> B[Cargo 判断哪些单元失效]
    B --> C[解析与宏展开]
    C --> D[类型检查、借用检查、MIR]
    D --> E[泛型单态化与生成 LLVM IR]
    E --> F[LLVM 优化与机器码]
    F --> G[链接 Mach-O 动态库]
    G --> H[N-API 复制、版本标记、声明生成、加载]
    H --> I[新进程验证行为与 worker]
```

三个不同的缓存层不能混为一谈：

1. Actions 缓存保存和传输目录。下载成功只说明文件存在。
2. Cargo fingerprint 决定某个编译单元是否仍然有效；失效原因包括源码、配置、环境变量和 build script 输入变化。
3. rustc incremental 在确实需要编译一个 crate 时，尝试复用内部查询和代码生成结果。

因此，`incremental=true` 不保证插件重编译只需数秒；恢复了 Actions 缓存也不保证 Cargo 显示 `Fresh`。日志中的 `Compiling` 同样不是「这个 crate 完整重做了一切」的证明。[Cargo profiles](https://doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/reference/profiles.html)、[Cargo fingerprint 调试](https://doc.crates.io/contrib/implementation/debugging.html)。

Cargo `--timings` 用于找慢 crate、并发和依赖阻塞。其 `codegen` 区域不等于纯系统链接时间。多个 crate 可以重叠执行，不能把耗时相加解释总墙钟时间；最值得改善的是关键路径上阻塞后续任务的单元。[Cargo timings](https://doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/reference/timings.html)。

进一步使用固定 nightly 的 `-Ztime-passes -Ztime-passes-format=json`：记录宏展开、类型检查、MIR、单态化、LLVM 和 `run_linker`。阶段存在嵌套和并行重叠，例如 `run_linker` 包含在 `link_binary` / `link` 内，不能相加。记录的 RSS 起止值也不是精确峰值内存。该参数是 rustc 内部诊断接口，脚本绑定本项目固定工具链。[time-passes](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/unstable-book/compiler-flags/time-passes.html)。

#### 已有数据指出的调查对象

以下是此前 O3、LTO off 实验的单次 Cargo timing；各行存在并发，不是优化后的预计节省量。

| crate | 单元总时间 | 前端区间 | codegen 区间 | 下一步假设 |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- |
| pi-builtins | 621.35s | 73.30s | 548.05s | 优化和代码生成重；先测降低开发优化级别与改动传播 |
| pi-shell | 532.32s | 274.59s | 257.73s | 前端同样重；测前端线程数与模块边界 |
| jj-lib | 386.72s | 124.53s | 262.19s | 外部大依赖；优先保留已编译状态 |
| pdf-inspector | 335.69s | 56.16s | 279.53s | 外部代码生成重；普通源码编辑应避免使其失效 |
| pi-natives | 165.50s | 未分开记录 | 未分开记录 | 用 rustc 阶段数据确定前端、LLVM、链接各自占比 |

O2、O3 的冷构建和不同缓存不能直接作为单变量因果比较。旧实验中 O3 ThinLTO 与 O3 LTO off 的插件重编译约为 603s 与 166s；旧实验修改时间戳，本轮修改真实行为。两者实际都关闭了 rustc incremental，配置和探针也不同，必须分别标注。

#### 第一轮：实际开发配置

远程运行 `44020319623` 比较既有 `local` / `dev`。固定 macOS Intel、Xcode 16.4、nightly-2026-11-08、Bun 1.4.4、Cargo 4 jobs、目标 triple 和 RUSTFLAGS。

每组首次编译后，再不改源码构建一次，然后依次改变同一个文本函数的 tab 宽度上限，验证新进程返回 17、18、19。每次都运行源码 worker smoke；结束后恢复为 16，并重新构建原始插件。

已定位并修复的阻碍：`@napi-rs/cli` 3.7.2 对显式 `--profile dev` 使用字面目录 `dev/`，而 Cargo 将内置 dev 产物放在 `debug/`。Rust 编译成功后，N-API 的复制步骤失败。`build-bindings.ts` 在选择 dev 时使用 N-API 的默认 debug 模式；自定义 profile 继续显式传参。无第三方依赖的小型动态库已复现失败，并验证修改后的路径可以复制、加载。修复后的 dev 补测运行 `44025049631`。

第一次失败还暴露了实验设施缺陷：只有加载成功才保存缓存，会丢失已经成功编译的目录。工作流已改为在安装或验证失败时也尽量保存构建状态，并始终上传 Cargo timing。

完整数据来自 [local 运行](https://github.com/NexusKMT/omp-slim/actions/runs/44020319623) 和 [修复后 dev 运行](https://github.com/NexusKMT/omp-slim/actions/runs/44025049631)：

| 配置 | 三次编辑到验证通过 | 中位数 | 仅构建安装中位数 |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: |
| local | 546.854 / 634.900 / 578.695s | 578.695s | 575.643s |
| dev | 49.666 / 82.761 / 60.547s | 60.547s | 56.752s |

在这两台相同规格 runner 的测试中，dev 中位数耗时约为 local 的 1/9.56，减少 89.54%。两组实际均关闭 incremental；profile 同时改变优化级别、LTO、codegen units、调试与检查选项，不能把全部收益归给一个选项。所有编辑都只编译 pi-natives 一个 Cargo 单元，排除了每次重编全部依赖的解释。未测量两种插件的完整运行性能代价。

local / dev 首次构建安装分别为 1854.519s / 2207.276s。第一次未改源码构建仍各编译两个单元，分别耗时 709.402s / 46.981s，不能用作稳定 no-op 基准。第二轮先稳定后测量的 no-op 是 1.805–3.835s、零编译单元。

两组恢复构建、原始 tab=16 行为、worker smoke、导出、6 项 PTY/shell 测试、15 项语法测试均通过；随后均在同一个 shell 会话并发测试失败，整个第一轮 workflow 仍标记失败，未上传「验证通过」的 addon。local 失败是把位于输出末尾的忙碌提示硬性要求放在开头；dev 失败是 100ms 自动后台化发生在 shell 选择之前，起始返回尚无提示。测试已改成以 owner 的真实输出确认占用，用显式释放文件维持重叠，并强制延迟另一个任务的准备，验证其完成结果披露 fork、读取原状态且不污染原会话。当前已安装的原 O3 插件上 24/24 重复测试通过，包类型检查 3220 文件通过；这项修正未在新 dev/local 产物上重跑，不把原失败改报为成功。

#### 第二轮：三个改动点 × 三种前端线程数

工作流输入 `compiler_matrix=true`，脚本为 `scripts/slim/benchmark-compiler.py`。

| 固定项 | 设置 |
| --- | --- |
| Profile | 现有 dev；pi-natives / pi-builtins O0，pi-shell O1；保留 unwind |
| 外部依赖与后端并发 | 依赖配置固定，Cargo jobs=4 |
| 自变量 | 对三个目标 crate 使用前端线程 1、2、4 |
| 采样 | 每个改动点 3 次不同的真实函数体变化 |
| 行为探针 | native tab 宽度；空路径 dirname；深层算术表达式错误 |
| 记录 | Cargo 失效原因、重编译单元、rustc pass JSON、完整插件构建安装、运行验证 |
| 完成条件 | 观察到新行为、源码 worker 通过、每组源码恢复、最终 export 校验 |

三种线程设置在三个独立 runner 上并行比较。各组先形成自己的编译状态，再连续编辑。所有组使用相同的计时工具；带诊断的绝对时间与不带诊断的第一轮分开分析。一次 runner、每种改动三次只能提供探索性证据，不能替代跨机器重复实验。Cargo 的四个 job 不等于所有 rustc 前端线程总数严格不超过四个；这也是测试线程增加是否导致资源争抢的原因。

实际主机均报告 i7-8700B、4 个逻辑 CPU、14 GiB 内存、Xcode 16.4。端到端中位数如下，包含插件安装、新行为探针与源码 worker smoke：

| 修改位置 | 前端 1 线程 | 前端 2 线程 | 前端 4 线程 | 实际重编译单元 |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- |
| pi-natives 文本函数 | 33.369s | 30.328s | 42.949s | pi-natives |
| pi-builtins dirname | 294.418s | 287.984s | 328.807s | pi-builtins → pi-shell → pi-natives |
| pi-shell 算术错误 | 212.364s | 234.473s | 199.504s | pi-shell → pi-natives |

线程数没有一致赢家。native 的 2 线程约快 9%，4 线程约慢 29%；shell 的三次样本范围分别为 211.716–298.838s、173.267–306.150s、161.339–237.252s，波动大且组间交叠。这些数据不支持把 4 线程设为通用优化，也不应把跨轮 native 从 60s 降到 30s 全归功于线程数。

Cargo 指纹日志确认：builtins 的函数体变化使它自身因 ChangedFile 失效，shell 和 native 因 StaleDepFingerprint 失效。第一线程组的一个样本中，builtins 从 0.75s 编译到 51.33s，shell 从 28.86s 到 242.89s，native 从 243.06s 到 289.38s。前两者有流水线重叠，真正拖住最后插件的是 shell；不能将三个 crate 时间简单相加。

#### 谁最难编译：阶段证据

下表取前端 1 线程组的三次样本中位数。各阶段嵌套或并行，**不能横向相加**；每一列的中位数也可能来自不同样本。

| 工作负载中的 crate | rustc 总耗时 | 类型检查 | MIR checking | codegen_crate | LLVM_thinlto | run_linker | rustc 峰值 RSS |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| native 编辑 → pi-natives | 29.012s | 3.679s | 3.836s | 16.710s | 无 | 1.941s | 1353 MiB |
| builtins 编辑 → pi-builtins | 71.833s | 11.116s | 11.014s | 31.891s | 无 | 不适用，生成 rlib | 1822 MiB |
| builtins 编辑 → pi-shell | 213.704s | 32.212s | 27.217s | 47.911s | 102.421s | 不适用，生成 rlib | 2829 MiB |
| shell 编辑 → pi-shell | 177.300s | 16.957s | 21.710s | 43.685s | 71.531s | 不适用，生成 rlib | 2835 MiB |

当前的重负担是 pi-shell 的后端优化，builtins 的改动还会触发这部分。pi-shell 的 O1 是为避免未优化递归栈过大而保留的例外，不能直接降为 O0。dev 的 `lto=false` 允许 crate 内部跨 codegen unit 的 ThinLTO；`lto="off"` 才完全关闭。固定工具链的 O1 微型工程在 incremental=false/true 两种情况下都实际执行了 LLVM_thinlto，因此启用增量并不等于自动消除这个阶段。[Cargo lto](https://doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/reference/profiles.html#lto)。

pi-natives 的最终系统链接器通常只有 2–4s。以 1 线程 native 样本为例，即使把 1.941s 系统链接耗时全部消掉，也只能减少约 6% 的 33.369s 端到端中位数；换链接器不是当前高收益方向。降低或避免重复 LLVM 工作才值得先验证。

CPU user+system 与墙钟之比显示 rustc 确实使用多个核心，例如 shell 编辑的 1 线程前端组约 489.5 CPU 秒 / 177.3 墙钟秒。这里「前端 1 线程」不表示后端也只能用一个 CPU。RSS 来自 wrapper 子进程 resource 统计，各 crate 峰值发生时间不同，不能相加当成整台机器峰值。

Rust wrapper 只对三个目标 crate 添加参数，避免为了诊断一个 crate 改变整张依赖图的 RUSTFLAGS。它必须保留 Cargo jobserver 文件描述符；否则 rustc 无法与 Cargo 协调代码生成并发，实验会改变资源调度。已用微型项目验证：添加 wrapper 后未改源码仍为 Fresh；真实改动输出更新；分阶段日志生成；jobserver 正常传递。

#### 断点与恢复

这里的断点指「已经完成并校验的编译状态」，包括工具链、profile、flags、target、源码内容摘要和时间戳。首次生成 N-API 声明可能改变 force-build 环境变量，因此先额外稳定一次，再测第三次完全未改源码的构建。

每个前端配置独立保存 cache。恢复时间戳前比较每个被跟踪文件的 SHA-256，只恢复内容完全一致的文件；内容变化保留新时间戳。新的 wrapper 或线程设置必须先重编译目标 crate，不能借用旧配置的 Fresh 状态。该实现并不承诺目录型 build script 输入、删除文件、外部路径或所有工具状态都能跨 runner 保持 Fresh；fingerprint 日志负责揭示剩余失效。

#### 下一步只做最小差分

1. 显式开启 incremental 后，只做一个 native 编辑的 smoke，先验证实际 rustc 命令和行为，再决定是否值得扩大采样。其完整项目加速量尚未知。
2. 在相同保留状态下只改一个变量：针对 shell 比较现有 local ThinLTO 与关闭 LTO，保留 O1 与 unwind；继续验证深层递归及错误后会话可用，并测运行性能。不要同时更换线程数、优化等级和 linker。
3. 若 shell 仍主导，再分析重泛型、宏展开与 crate 边界。单个 builtins 行为检查可先使用包级 test/check；完整 addon 是后续集成门槛。

本轮没有再启动长编译，没有修改 dev 的 LTO 设置，也没有宣称一个未经测量的秒数。开发时 TypeScript 继续复用已验证 addon，使用 `bun run dev`；在允许完整编译的远程保留环境，Rust 开发命令可显式使用 `CARGO_INCREMENTAL=1 OMP_NATIVE_CARGO_PROFILE=dev bun run build:native`。profile 改变后的首次构建仍需建立状态；本机完整编译限制不变。

已提交的 [测量数据](doc-artifacts/slim-compiler-measurements-2026-11-17.json) 保存全部 27 个样本、分阶段中位数和 profile 对比。本地原始证据位于 `dist/validation/development-benchmark-2026-11-17/` 与 `dist/validation/compiler-diagnostics-2026-11-17/`。后者的 `matrix-analysis.json` 保存三组聚合，`remote-matrix/` 保存全部 Cargo HTML、实际 rustc 参数和 pass JSON，`ci-incremental-probe.json` / `effective-profile-guard.json` / `tiny-thinlto-incremental.json` 保存机制复现。线上证据 artifact 保留 7 天，本地副本已回收。

### OMP Slim：开发反馈加速调研（2026-11-17）

目标是缩短“改动源码 → 得到有用反馈 → 运行新行为”的时间。研究结合当前实现、已有 macOS 构建记录、官方文档、维护者博客和开源项目的实际改动。

**优先验证现有 `dev` 配置与持久工作区；随后解决跨 runner 的缓存失效；最后按测量结果决定拆 crate、拆 addon 或更换链接器。** 目前没有证据证明完整 native 插件能在数秒内重编译。上一轮测得的 2 分 46 秒来自关闭 rustc 增量编译的 `ci` 配置。

#### 1. 当前实现与测量说明了什么

| 当前路径 | 实际设置或行为 | 对开发反馈的影响 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| TypeScript 源码运行 | `bun run dev`，复用已验证 addon | 已验证临时源码修改能在下一次启动显示，0.28 秒；无需编译 native |
| 默认 native 构建 | `build-bindings.ts` 默认 `local`：O3、ThinLTO、incremental=true | 开启增量，但仍承担较重的优化成本 |
| 远程完整构建 | `scripts/slim/build.sh` 强制 `ci`：O3、LTO off、incremental=false | 适合验证分发产物；此前插件重编译数据不能代表 dev 增量体验 |
| 已有 `dev` 配置 | 自有代码 O0、incremental=true；`pi-shell` 单独 O1；外部依赖 O2 | 已经具备候选开发配置，首先测试它，不必先增加更多 profile |
| GitHub Actions | 恢复 target 后在新 checkout 构建 | 恢复缓存、Cargo 判定产物可复用、rustc 复用增量状态是三件不同的事 |

本次只生成了 Cargo unit graph，没有执行完整 native 构建。解析结果确认：`pi-natives`、`pi-builtins` 在 `dev` 下为 O0/incremental=true，`pi-shell` 为 O1/incremental=true；三者在之前的 `ci` graph 中均为 O3/incremental=false。

已有 O3/no-LTO 报告中，`pi-builtins` 为 621.35 秒，其中 codegen 段约 548.05 秒；`pi-shell` 为 532.32 秒，其中前端段约 274.59 秒。前者值得先降低开发时的优化成本；后者还需要关注类型检查、宏展开和模块边界。各 crate 的时间会重叠，不能相加当成总构建耗时。`pi-natives` 的 164.58 秒没有前端、LLVM 与系统链接器的细分，不能全部称为链接时间。[Cargo timings 官方说明](https://doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/reference/timings.html)

本地证据：

- `Cargo.toml` 的 `profile.dev` / `profile.local` / `profile.ci`。
- `packages/natives/scripts/build-bindings.ts` 的 profile 选择，以及 `scripts/slim/build.sh` 的强制覆盖。
- `dist/validation/build-perf-2026-11-17/*timing-summary.json`、`default-ci-unit-graph.json`。
- `dist/validation/dev-acceleration-research-2026-11-17/dev-unit-graph.json`。

#### 2. 推荐顺序

| 优先级 | 方法 | 本项目适配性 | 需要验证的边界 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 用现有 `dev` 构建 native，保持编译状态 | 高；已有实现支持选 profile | 完整 addon 加载、panic 恢复、shell 栈限制、运行速度 |
| 1 | 保留 checkout、target、工具链、SDK、flags | 高；直接针对连续编辑 | 需要可保留磁盘状态的远程开发环境；Linux 产物不能用于本地 macOS |
| 1 | 受影响 crate 的检查/测试，随后才构建 addon | 已在 `pi-pty` 验证 | 单元测试通过不等于新 native 行为已进入 CLI |
| 2 | workspace 缓存 + checksum freshness | 有官方支持和 uv 实践；小型机制验证通过 | `build.rs` 输入仍用 mtime，完整项目收益尚未测量 |
| 2 | 对前端重的 crate 比较 1 / 2 / 4 个前端线程 | 固定工具链支持；`pi-shell` 有较长前端阶段 | 与 Cargo 并发、内存一起测量，不能保证线程越多越快 |
| 2 | 拆分大 crate，缩小改动影响范围 | `pi-pty` 已验证有效；大 crate 需设计 | 避免形成更长的串行依赖链，保留真实实现和功能 |
| 3 | 对最终 crate 做 self-profile，再优化链接或泛型 | 有明确诊断工具 | 当前没有足够数据认定链接是剩余主因 |
| 3 | 独立 addon / 开发期动态库 | Bevy、cargo-add-dynamic 有先例 | 需要处理加载、共享类型、生命周期、ABI 与打包；工程成本高 |
| 暂缓 | sccache、Cranelift、Wild 直接替换现有方案 | 各有适用场景，但不能直接解决当前 macOS native 路径 | 详见后文限制 |

#### 3. 首选：真正使用开发配置，并保留编译状态

Cargo 官方文档区分了优化级别、增量编译和 package override。增量数据保存在 target；注册表依赖本身不使用 rustc 增量编译，自有代码与 path dependency 才是重点。把不会频繁改变的依赖保持适当优化、让频繁修改的代码低优化，是可行的开发配置。[Cargo profiles](https://doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/reference/profiles.html)

Zed 是可参考的实际大型项目：其 `dev` 开启 incremental，分别配置 proc-macro 和少数运行热点；同时对齐 build dependency 的配置，注释明确指出不对齐会导致大量重复编译。它还针对小 crate 单独调整 codegen units，说明该参数不应一概追求越大越好。[Zed Cargo.toml，核对时提交 482e7652](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/blob/482e76524bd33d8cbdfc352f1fef3eefbf2fad92/Cargo.toml)

本项目的第一项候选实验是在远程构建环境执行：

```sh
# 在准备好的远程 checkout 中执行；此处是候选方案，未执行完整构建。
# CARGO_TARGET_DIR 应指向该开发环境长期保留的目录。
OMP_NATIVE_CARGO_PROFILE=dev bun run build:native
```

先使用现有 `dev`，保留 `pi-shell` 的 O1 例外。该例外是为了避免未优化递归栈帧触发测试线程栈溢出，不能为了编译快一律改 O0。保留 `panic=unwind` 与 `split-debuginfo=unpacked`，后者用于 macOS 文件/行号回溯。若之后测试 `lto="off"`、不同 codegen units 或外部依赖 O1，应一次只改一个变量，避免把配置迁移的首次成本混入连续编辑数据。

固定 Rust toolchain、目标 triple、SDK、features、RUSTFLAGS 和 target 路径。完整 addon 与其相关测试还应对齐显式 target，避免分别使用 `target/debug` 和 `target/<triple>/debug`。首次采用 `dev` 会建立一套不同于 O3 的依赖产物，不能承诺首次构建同样快。

持久远程 checkout 可以避免每次清空源码时间戳、恢复大体积 target 和重新安装工具链。Linux 开发环境可承担跨平台 Rust 逻辑测试与 Linux CLI 验证；在本地 Intel Mac 观察新 native 行为，仍需要 macOS 构建产物。现有规则要求完整 native 构建远程执行，本次没有启动本地完整构建或创建新的远程机器。

#### 4. 免费托管 Actions 路径：内容校验值得试，但有真实边界

Cargo nightly 的 checksum freshness 用输入内容决定是否需要重编译，适合源码时间戳不稳定的 CI。当前文档明确指出，`build.rs` 的 `rerun-if-changed` 输入仍按时间戳处理。[Cargo unstable：checksum-freshness](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/cargo/reference/unstable.html#checksum-freshness)

在我们固定的 `nightly-2026-11-08` 上，以下组合已用于独立小例子：

```sh
CARGO_BUILD_FINGERPRINT=content cargo build -Zchecksum-freshness
```

相应候选配置为：

```toml
[unstable]
checksum-freshness = true

[build]
fingerprint = "content"
```

本次创建了无第三方依赖的双 crate 程序，比较默认 mtime 与内容模式。执行程序输出值用于确认真正的代码修改被编译，而不只看 Cargo 的退出码。

| 情景 | 默认 mtime | 内容校验 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 不改文件再次构建 | 两个 crate 均 Fresh | 两个 crate 均 Fresh |
| 原样重写源码和 manifests，模拟新 checkout 时间戳 | 两个 crate 均重编译 | 两个 crate 均 Fresh |
| 修改依赖源码，且在内容模式故意保留旧 mtime 和文件长度 | 正常修改后输出更新 | 正确检测到内容变化，两个 crate 重编译，输出 41 → 42 |
| 加入读取输入文件并生成代码的 `build.rs`，原样重写全部输入 | 重编译 | 脚本可执行文件 Fresh，但依赖库和应用仍重编译 |
| 同上，但生成文件只在内容变化时写入 | 重编译 | 依赖库和应用仍重编译 |

无 build script 的“原样重写”样例为 0.871 秒与 0.092 秒。这只证明机制，不能外推为 OMP 提速倍数。三组实验共 24 次构建；日志、脚本和结果保存在 `dist/validation/dev-acceleration-research-2026-11-17/`。

该限制确实与本项目有关：`pi-shell/build.rs` 监视 minimizer 定义目录并生成 `builtin_filters.toml`；`pi-natives/build.rs` 监视语法资源，还构建 OAuth callback helper。仅增加 checksum 开关，或只把生成文件改成 write-if-changed，都不足以保证 fresh checkout 下这些 crate 不重编译。应记录 Cargo dirty 原因，必要时拆出独立的生成步骤或生成资产 crate。只有“输入内容确认相同”的时间戳恢复才可研究，不能简单将所有源文件日期改旧来追求命中。

uv 有已合并的相近实践，而非只有建议：

- [PR #20448，Linux workspace 缓存](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/20448)：2026-07-15 合并。保留 workspace 产物并加入 checksum freshness，5 组样本的恢复后编译从 68.7 秒到 54.6 秒；缓存变大，恢复也有额外成本。
- [PR #20451，macOS tests](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/20451)：同日合并；5 组样本的恢复后编译从 159.0 秒到 84.4 秒。但同时采用 nightly 与 aborting tests，不能把全部收益归因于缓存。
- [PR #20458，development builds](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/20458)：2026-07-16 合并。macOS x86_64 的暖编译均值 97.6 → 77.8 秒，置信区间跨过无改善；作者明确认为该平台结论尚不确定。不能据此承诺我们 Intel Mac 同样提速。

我们的缓存已经包含整个 target；重点是让其中 workspace 产物保持可用，而不是机械换一个 cache action。`Swatinem/rust-cache` 默认不保留 workspace crates，并默认关闭 incremental，虽然现在提供 `cache-workspace-crates` 选项。直接套默认配置可能背离开发反馈目标。[rust-cache README](https://github.com/Swatinem/rust-cache)

GitHub cache 内容不可原地更新。因此缓存方案应使用兼容性前缀（工具链、平台/SDK、profile、features、关键 flags）与可更新的快照 key；不能只固定一个 Cargo.lock key 后期望它自动吸收最新 workspace 产物。依赖下载缓存与编译缓存也可以分别管理。是否值得保留更大的 target，必须比较恢复、保存、编译、下载 addon 的总耗时。[GitHub dependency caching](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/workflows-and-actions/dependency-caching)

#### 5. 结构优化：减少一次修改会触发的工作

rust-analyzer 维护者 matklad 的经验是把依赖图做宽：公共类型处于底层，功能模块相互独立，顶层只组合它们。仅把一个 crate 切成串行链条，不一定改善编译。[Fast Rust Builds](https://matklad.github.io/2021/09/04/fast-rust-builds.html)

`pi-pty` 已证明这一方法在本项目可行：共享同一份实际实现，同时避免测试牵引整个 native 图。后续候选是把 `pi-shell` 的解析/最小化等纯逻辑、`pi-builtins` 的独立命令组、native 中可独立验证的算法提取为边界清晰的 crate。共享 host 类型或协议应放在共同底层，避免让每个小 crate 再依赖完整 shell。

拆成 rlib 可以缩小编译和测试范围，但最后的单一 `.node` 仍需要链接。若开发配置下最终链接仍占主要时间，再研究独立 addon 或开发期动态库：

- Bevy 的 `dynamic_linking` 让稳定引擎依赖在开发期以动态库复用；其文档同时要求发布时考虑取消该设置和附加动态库的分发问题。[Bevy fast compiles](https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy-website/blob/main/content/learn/book/development-practices/fast-compiles.md)
- `cargo-add-dynamic` 作者的 Polars 实例中，一次编辑后的编译约 2.896 → 0.485 秒；其计时进一步显示节省主要来自链接。文章也解释了多个动态库共享依赖时的 diamond dependency 限制。[作者的实际实验](https://robert.kra.hn/posts/2022-09-09-speeding-up-incremental-rust-compilation-with-dylibs/)

OMP 的单个 `.node` 虽然已经是 cdylib，其 Rust 依赖仍通常静态并入该产物，不能据文件后缀认为已获得上述收益。较稳妥的架构候选是按可独立加载的能力拆 N-API addon，并保持 TypeScript API 门面；Rust dylib 包装则必须验证 toolchain/ABI、共享类型、错误恢复和加载路径。两者都属于较大工程，优先级低于现有 dev 配置与缓存问题。

#### 6. 编译器与链接器：测量后选择

对最终 crate 使用 rustc self-profile / measureme，区分宏展开、类型检查、单态化、LLVM、系统链接。Cargo timings 用于依赖关键路径；`cargo llvm-lines` 可用于找重复生成大量 IR 的泛型。Rust Performance Book 提供了把大型泛型函数的非泛型主体移出的实例，适合在发现真实热点后采用。[rustc profiling](https://rustc-dev-guide.rust-lang.org/profiling.html)、[Rust Performance Book](https://nnethercote.github.io/perf-book/compile-times.html)

还有一个值得独立比较的编译器选项：**前端并行**。固定 rustc 提交的 `parse_jobs_all` 默认选择单线程；可使用 `--jobs-frontend=2`（配合 `-Zunstable-options`），兼容的 `-Zthreads=2` 也能启用。已用本机固定工具链的 `--print cfg` 验证两种参数被接受，尚未测量 OMP 加速幅度。对于约 275 秒前端阶段的 `pi-shell`，在远程 4 vCPU 环境比较 1 / 2 / 4 个前端线程比盲目提高全局 `-j` 更有针对性；需要同时观察峰值内存和整个依赖图的总时间。该机制不能消除所有前端串行工作，也不应把最新 nightly 的默认值套到固定版本上。[固定版本 rustc 并发参数实现](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/blob/f5cedb83a788ea9581097abc36a2a8503a7f541c/compiler/rustc_session/src/config.rs#L1790)

| 方法 | 研究结论 |
| --- | --- |
| macOS 的 LLD-MachO | 是有效候选；LLVM 官方支持，但不能把对旧 ld64 的宣传倍数套在 Xcode 16.4 上。只有确认链接占比高后，才与当前 Apple linker 比较。 |
| sccache | 可研究远程重复依赖编译；官方明确不缓存调用系统链接器的 cdylib/bin/proc-macro，也不缓存 incremental 编译。本项目最关心的最终 addon 和频繁修改的自有 crate 不能因此直接加速。 |
| Cranelift | 固定工具链对应 README 支持 macOS x64，但 panic unwinding 在 macOS 不支持，默认 abort。OMP 的 shell 和 native task 依赖 catch_unwind，故不能直接作为 macOS addon 的替代后端。 |
| Wild | 当前 README 将 Mach-O 和真正的 incremental linking 列为未来工作；不能解决当前 macOS 链接。Linux 可另行评估。 |
| zld | 旧博客仍推荐，但仓库已经归档，不作为新投入方向。 |
| 更大并发、更多 codegen units | 当前瓶颈包含单 crate 的前端工作和依赖关键路径，不是增加 `-j` 就能消除；先用 CPU/内存和 timings 判断。 |

来源：[LLD-MachO](https://lld.llvm.org/MachO/index.html)、[sccache Rust 支持](https://github.com/mozilla/sccache/blob/main/docs/Rust.md)、[固定 rustc 提交的 Cranelift README](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/blob/f5cedb83a788ea9581097abc36a2a8503a7f541c/compiler/rustc_codegen_cranelift/Readme.md)、[Wild](https://github.com/wild-linker/wild)、[zld](https://github.com/michaeleisel/zld)。

#### 7. 下一轮实验应怎样做

1. **选一个远程环境、一个固定 checkout 和 target。** 首先比较现有 `local` 与现有 `dev`；把每种配置的首次预热成本单独记录。免费托管 Actions 的同一 job 可以先验证连续编辑收益，但不能据此宣称跨 job 同样快。
2. **每个配置分别测量三类改动。** `pi-natives` 一个函数体、`pi-shell` 一个真实逻辑改动、共享 crate 的接口改动。记录检查反馈、addon 构建、安装及 source smoke 的分段与总时间；每类至少重复三次，不只 touch 文件。
3. **记录真正的重编译集合。** 同时保存 Cargo timings、JSON Fresh 状态、必要的 fingerprint dirty 日志。最终 crate 另取一次 self-profile，避免先入为主认定链接慢。
4. **再验证新的 checkout。** 复用上一轮产物，比较 mtime / content freshness；专门检查 `pi-shell`、语法资源和 OAuth helper 的 build-script 行为。更改生成输入时必须能更新最终行为。
5. **通过完整 addon 验证后才固定默认。** 验证加载、保留 API、PTY 回压/取消、worker smoke、shell panic 恢复。运行变慢或栈限制退化不能被编译加速抵消。

建议的验收目标是：普通 TypeScript 修改维持秒级反馈；独立 Rust 逻辑继续以定向测试提供秒级反馈；native 函数体修改首先争取明显低于当前 2 分 46 秒，再讨论是否有条件达到几十秒。这是实验目标，尚不是测得的结果。

本次没有更改构建配置、启动完整 native 构建或创建远程资源。报告之外只保存了来源快照、只读 unit graph，以及隔离的微型验证程序。资料快照与来源索引在 `dist/validation/dev-acceleration-research-2026-11-17/`。

### AST WASM build comparison — 2026-11-17

Disabling optional AST WASM grammars reduced the native addon by 5.67 MB and
the standalone CLI by 1.75 MB, but did not speed up this build from the existing
WASM-enabled cache. Both configurations built successfully and passed the
worker smoke, grammar regressions and macOS PTY tests.

Measured source: `ce08acb110f3e87d15bed132473706352ade641e`, on
`perf/wasm-build-2026-11-17`. This includes the preceding cleanup snapshot.
The local main working tree contains these implementation changes; this test
branch has not been merged into main.

- [macOS comparison run](https://github.com/NexusKMT/omp-slim/actions/runs/43931958426)
- [Rust validation with WASM disabled](https://github.com/NexusKMT/omp-slim/actions/runs/43932030567)

#### Measurement

Both jobs used macOS 15 Intel, Xcode 16.4, Bun 1.4.4, the pinned Rust toolchain,
the `ci` profile (ThinLTO, 16 codegen units), 4 Cargo jobs and
`-C target-cpu=x86-64-v3`. Both reported an Intel i7-8700B, 4 exposed cores and
14 GiB of memory. They ran on separate hosted runners and restored the same
immutable cache:

`slim-macos15-intel-xcode16.4-ci-v1-8f312bb89b577fc52697d8941407e643134b8dca88cc5d9d7664cd00d67ec3be`

| Measurement | WASM enabled | WASM disabled | Change |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Cargo native compilation | 22m 19s | 24m 42s | +2m 23s |
| Native build including bindings/install checks | 22m 30s | 24m 50s | +2m 20s |
| CLI build | 59s | 54s | -5s |
| PTY test target compilation | 13m 11s | 19m 02s | +5m 51s |
| PTY tests themselves | 3.020s | 2.988s | approximately equal |
| Cache restoration | 2m 28s | 4m 48s | +2m 20s |
| Entire job, including setup and artifact upload | 40m 59s | 51m 49s | +10m 50s |
| Native addon | 100,105,512 bytes | 94,436,136 bytes | -5,669,376 bytes (-5.66%) |
| Standalone CLI | 196,118,128 bytes | 194,367,856 bytes | -1,750,272 bytes (-0.89%) |

This measures switching from an existing cache, not clean compilation or a
steady-state warm build. The enabled build reused Wasmtime/Cranelift without
recompiling them. The disabled feature graph invalidated Tree-sitter and
several shared dependencies, including Git-related libraries. The native build
logged 44 package compilations when disabled versus 21 when enabled. The
additional work and hosted-runner variation limit causal conclusions from this
single pair. Cache and setup time are not native compilation time.

The normal/build dependency graph for `x86_64-apple-darwin` dropped from 589 to
554 distinct package/version pairs, or 564 to 531 package names. All 20
Wasmtime/Cranelift package names left that graph. The lockfile still records
optional dependencies so the explicitly enabled configuration remains pinned.

#### Cargo timing evidence

The uploaded native build reports contain these compilation-unit durations.
Units overlap, so their durations must not be added as wall time. Cargo does
not separately break down code generation and linking for the final
`pi-natives` unit in these reports.

| Unit | WASM enabled | WASM disabled |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| `pi-natives` | 785.40s | 673.21s |
| `pi-shell` | 352.64s | 542.49s |
| `pi-builtins` | 289.06s | 516.54s |
| `pi-vcs` | 141.09s | 208.42s |
| `jj-lib` | cached | 368.50s |

The final `pi-natives` unit shortened by 112.19s, but started later: 808.26s
after compilation began, versus 553.99s with WASM enabled. The build's long
dependency path continues through the shell/builtins and final native addon.
Reducing optional grammar support alone did not remove that bottleneck.

#### Behavior and validation

`pi-ast` and `pi-natives` default to no WASM. An explicit native build with
`OMP_NATIVE_FEATURES=wasm-grammars` restores optional grammar loading for
comparison or broader language support. The PTY test wrapper forwards that
selection so each comparison measures the intended feature graph.

The native grammar metadata reports whether this build can load each grammar.
Disabled grammars do not download or trigger repeated AST calls, and cached
modules from an older build cannot make unsupported parsing fail. Structural
tools explain skipped languages. The built-in language set remains available;
other languages retain ordinary text operations.

- Both macOS jobs passed standalone worker smoke, 15 grammar regressions and
  all 7 selected PTY tests (335 unrelated tests filtered out).
- Rust formatting and Clippy passed. The Linux job passed 6,218 nextest tests
  (52 skipped) and 6 doctests (27 ignored), completing in 13m 04s. Test-target
  compilation took 4m 21s and nextest execution took 305.721s.
- Local `check:ts`, formatting, workflow parsing and 15 focused tests passed.
  Local tests initially used the prior addon; both freshly compiled modes were
  then checked on their macOS runners.
- The full TypeScript runtime suite was not part of this timing experiment.

Both downloaded archives were SHA-256 verified:

| Mode | Archive SHA-256 |
| --- | --- |
| enabled | `0e024f3d7cd4f12c34c6b94704fc3a5624b09db5695c3492cc2ab088d73fd4ae` |
| disabled | `657ca033b70f8aaad249ae642d6047829de4712570e84a58e5d1e963fb424112` |

Full logs, metrics, Cargo HTML timing reports, generated bindings and binaries
were recovered under `dist/validation/wasm-2026-11-17/` locally. Its manifest
records source identity, run IDs, configuration, results and evidence hashes.

### 裁剪后的启发式审计（2026-11-19）

> Historical audit on the `e8d1f678b3` working tree. The later integration with
> `ea3ca64360` preserves additional remote removals (catalog merged into ai;
> stats, metaharness, research and many old tests removed). Counts and validation
> below describe that earlier tree, not the integrated build. See the build and
> maintenance-cost report for the final source and verification.

审计对象是 `main@e8d1f678b34eb123e0af913032498db0ba931506` 加上[本轮维护脚本修复](#维护脚本裁剪对账2026-11-19)后的工作区。下文保留修复前的证据与复现记录。用户确认开始后，H1–H9 已完成修复，P3 的无消费者代码已清理；最新实现及验证见[修复报告](#启发式审计修复2026-11-19)和[供应商残留清理](#供应商专用研究与残留清理2026-11-19)。

原始审计结论：存在同类遗漏，覆盖主 CLI、benchmark 配置生成、独立 Python 请求客户端、开发命令、欢迎提示及开发规范。此前通过的 `check:ts` 和脚本测试不能覆盖这些情况。

#### 方法与范围

- 对 4,525 个 TS/TSX/JS/MJS 文件做语法级导入扫描，共提取 26,507 条导入记录；对相对路径和 `@oh-my-pi/` 内部包引用进行静态解析。最终无扫描解析错误，发现 3 条失效模块引用，分布于 2 个 benchmark 文件。此扫描不验证命名导出，也不覆盖运行时拼接的模块路径。
- 检查根目录和 12 个工作区包的 manifest，共 166 个脚本定义；核对直接文件入口和 `bun --cwd … run …` 转发目标。
- 搜索已退休协议、模型角色、供应商默认值、固定请求地址及已删除组件名称；对命中追踪消费者。历史元数据、迁移清理代码、测试数据及本地指令格式兼容不直接记为问题。
- 对原有包 tsconfig 未包含的 `packages/*/bench/**/*.ts` 和 `.omp/**/*.ts` 额外运行 `bun check`。
- 用临时配置复现 CLI 错误；用假的 VM 接口捕获真实配置生成函数的输出，再交给当前 schema 校验；用 HTTP 调用拦截验证 Python 请求地址。没有调用真实模型服务，没有启动 Docker、Vibemon 或远端 benchmark。

以下优先级表示修复顺序。P1 是正常入口可复现的功能阻断；P2 是工具链、运行约定或文档与实现不一致；P3 是待删除消费者复核的清理候选。

#### 已确认的问题

##### H1 · P1 · `cleanse` 默认模型仍是已退休的 `@smol`

证据：

- `packages/coding-agent/src/commands/cleanse.ts:24` 的 CLI flag 默认值为 `@smol`。
- `packages/coding-agent/src/cleanse/index.ts:21` 和 `:61` 的共享入口也回退到 `@smol`。
- `packages/coding-agent/src/cleanse/agent.ts:77` 调用当前 `resolveCliModel`，解析失败后直接抛错。

在临时 profile 中配置 `model: audit/chat` 和一个 `auth: none` 的 Chat Completions 模型，运行源码 CLI 的 `cleanse 'check types'`，退出码为 1：

```text
Resolving model @smol...
error: Model "@smol" is not configured.
```

这会阻断未显式传 `--model` 的 cleanse 请求路径，项目本身配置有效也无法绕过。`runCleanse` 的共享默认值还影响使用该入口的交互流程。应让它选择当前主模型，并补充省略 `--model` 的命令行为回归。

##### H2 · P1 · 三处 benchmark 安装路径生成已不接受的模型配置

证据：

- `packages/metaharness/src/runner.ts:1307` 的 `writeModelsYaml`。
- `packages/metaharness/src/tb/agent.ts:106` 的 `installAgent` 配置生成。
- `packages/metaharness/agent/omp_local.py:497` 的 Python 安装路径。

这三处仍输出 `auth: oauth`、`transport: pi-native`，且没有当前必需的 `models` 数组。当前契约见 `packages/coding-agent/src/config/models-config-schema-bundle.ts:64`。

实际执行 TB 的 `installAgent`，通过假的 VM 接口捕获生成的 `models.yml`，再交给 `ModelsConfigSchema.assert`，得到：

```text
providers.audit.auth must be "apiKey" or "none" (was "oauth")
providers.audit.models must be an array (was missing)
providers.audit.transport must be removed
```

因此更换 `--model` 本身也不足以让这些安装路径适配 Slim。应统一生成显式 Chat Completions endpoint/model 配置，验证各安装分支的实际产物；不能靠恢复被删除的协议来消除错误。

##### H3 · P2 · 评测入口仍直接调用专有供应商协议

这部分存在实际 HTTP 请求实现：

- `packages/snapcompact/research/anthropic_api.py:10` 固定 `https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages`，`:14` 从指定 env 文件读取 `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`，`:62` 构造请求。
- `packages/metaharness/src/adapters/snapcompact.py:56` 导入这个客户端，`:310` 默认模型为 `claude-fable-5`。
- `packages/metaharness/src/server.ts:398` 的 SnapCompact launch 路径会启动上述 adapter。
- `packages/snapcompact/research/providers.py:19`、`:20`、`:221` 仍保留 Anthropic Messages、OpenAI Responses 和固定 OpenRouter 地址。

通过替换 `urllib.request.urlopen` 捕获真实 `anthropic_api.complete` 构造的请求，确认目标仍是 Anthropic Messages，携带 `x-api-key` 和 `anthropic-version`，没有经过 OMP 的主模型解析器。调用使用假 key 和内存响应，未读取真实凭据或发起网络请求。

应将仍保留的评测入口迁移到 Slim 的配置与传输；如定位为历史研究资料，应明确归档并从活动 launch 路径解除注册。不能把所有 `research/` 文件默认视为不可达资料。

##### H4 · P2 · 另外四处评测默认值仍覆盖本地模型选择

| 位置 | 当前行为 |
| --- | --- |
| `packages/metaharness/src/runner.ts:400` | 未传模型时固定选择 `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6` |
| `packages/metaharness/src/tb/cli.ts:14`、`:98` | 默认七个 OpenRouter 模型，解析默认参数已确认 |
| `scripts/edit_benchmark_common.py:33`、`:852` | 默认静态多供应商模型列表，直接传给 RPC 客户端 |
| `scripts/rate-edit-tool.py:47`、`:54`、`:1429`、`:1504` | 固定测试模型列表及 Claude oracle 模型 |

这些默认值未读取当前主模型，可能导致当前配置下直接找不到模型，也可能在另有配置时选择用户未显式指定的评测模型。应保留明确指定的评测矩阵能力，将默认值改为主模型或要求显式指定矩阵。

##### H5 · P2 · 根目录仍公布两个失效的生成命令

`package.json:125` 和 `:126` 的 `gen:compat`、`gen:models` 转发到 catalog 包，但 `packages/catalog/package.json` 已没有这两个脚本，原生成目录也已删除。

两条命令均已实际执行，退出码为 1：

```text
error: Script not found "gen:compat"
error: Script not found "gen:models"
```

应删除失效命令和相应开发指导，或在确实存在新生成需求时替换为现存入口。

##### H6 · P2 · benchmark 未纳入常规类型检查，已有多处接口漂移

`packages/coding-agent/tsconfig.json:3`、`packages/catalog/tsconfig.json:3` 只包含 `src`、`test`、`scripts`，没有 `bench`。额外检查共报告 32 个诊断，涉及 11 个文件。其中 `.omp/tools/tui.ts` 的 5 个诊断源于独立可选依赖未安装，单独列在后文；其余是 10 个 benchmark 文件中的 27 个代码诊断。

| 文件 | 发现 |
| --- | --- |
| `packages/catalog/bench/classify.bench.ts:9` | 导入已删除的 `compat/cascade`、`compat/taxonomy`；实际执行报模块不存在 |
| `packages/coding-agent/bench/muse-hashline.ts:5` | 仍导入已删除的 Responses provider、`getBundledModel`，并访问退休模型属性；实际执行报模块不存在 |
| `packages/coding-agent/bench/session-tree-nav.bench.ts:11` | 从旧模块导入已搬迁的 `buildSessionContext` 和类型；实际执行报命名导出不存在 |
| `packages/coding-agent/bench/speculative-shadow-planning.bench.ts:24` | 将已改为异步的 `projectJavaScriptShadowPlan` 当作同步返回值；实际执行在 `plan.operations.length` 抛出 TypeError |
| `packages/coding-agent/bench/event-fanout.bench.ts:64` | 仍传递已删除的 `ignoreLocalModelConfig` 选项 |

| `packages/coding-agent/bench/transcript-compose.bench.ts:108` | 主题初始化使用旧参数类型 |
| `packages/agent/bench/normalize-tools.bench.ts:24` | `unknown` schema 与当前 `TSchema` 契约不匹配 |
| `packages/tui/bench/markdown-stream.ts:69` | Markdown heading 回调参数已漂移 |
| `packages/utils/bench/sse-raw.bench.ts:42` | 保存测量对象的数组仍标注为 `number[]`，导致 10 个类型诊断；不能据此断言运行时必然失败 |

应删除仅服务于已裁剪功能的 benchmark，迁移仍有价值的 benchmark，并为保留目录设置类型检查入口。当前全仓格式检查覆盖这些文件，类型检查并未覆盖。

##### H7 · P2 · 欢迎提示与主 README 仍公布退休能力

- `packages/tui/src/prompt/tips.txt:19`、`:20`、`:28`、`:29` 仍推荐供应商 `/login`、`omp auth-broker` / `auth-gateway`、`/usage reset` 和 `PI_DIALECT`。这些入口或设置在当前实现中已移除。
- `packages/tui/src/prompt/welcome.ts:16`、`:24` 会嵌入这份提示列表，普通启动界面仍可能显示它们。
- `README.md:328` 开始仍宣称内置大量供应商与 OAuth 流程；`:379` 明确列出当前 schema 已拒绝的多种协议。
- `README.md:191` 和提示列表 `:30` 对 advisor 使用独立模型的描述与单主模型约定不符。

应依据实际命令注册、模型 schema 和单主模型实现更新使用说明。兼容任意自定义 Chat Completions 端点的能力可以保留，不能以此宣称旧供应商登录和原生协议仍可用。

##### H8 · P2 · `AGENTS.md` 仍强制采用已删除的 KDL / 模型目录流程

`AGENTS.md:205` 至模型生成章节仍要求在 `packages/catalog/src/compat/rules/` 修改 KDL、调用 `classifyModel`、生成 `rules.json` / `models.json`，并执行上面已经失效的生成命令。当前 `packages/catalog/src/compat`、`packages/catalog/scripts` 均不存在。

这些是实际交给 coding agents 的开发指令，可能使后续修改寻找不存在的入口或恢复已裁剪的架构。应以当前手工 endpoint/model schema、显式能力字段和单一传输契约替换过时说明。

##### H9 · P2 · 会话审计的模型配置与数据目录解析不一致

`scripts/session-stats/audit.ts:40`、`:41` 将会话和缓存固定在 `os.homedir()/.omp/...`；`:542` 直接从该会话根目录扫描。它没有使用现有 `getSessionsDir()` / profile 目录解析。

上一轮修复后的模型选择已经读取隔离目录和当前配置，但统计输入仍固定为默认 home 下的会话。使用 `PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR`、自定义配置根目录或其他 profile 时，模型配置和统计数据可能来自不同位置。

此项由路径和调用链静态确认，未扫描真实用户会话做复现。应统一目录解析，或提供明确的 `--sessions-root` / 缓存路径参数，并验证 profile 隔离。

#### P3 清理候选

以下仅确认仓内生产消费者缺失，不能据此保证外部 SDK 用户没有使用深层导出：

| 位置 | 证据与限制 |
| --- | --- |
| `packages/coding-agent/src/config/codex-attestation.ts` | 91 行；`generateCodexAttestation` 无仓内调用，旧 Codex 请求路径已删除；不能据此声称当前聊天仍发送 attestation |

共享模型解析器位于 `packages/coding-agent/src/config/configured-model.ts`，维护脚本保留 `scripts/configured-model.ts` 兼容入口。解析器遵循项目配置优先级、禁用供应商及显式选择规则，并支持 API key 的环境变量、命令值和本地凭据存储。

评测导出冻结已解析的认证值，避免 guest 环境重新解释变量名或命令前缀；大小写不同的请求头按 HTTP 规则覆盖。显式 endpoint override 不携带原端点的认证头。Host 与 guest 的模型配置文件使用 `600` 权限，dry-run 隐藏请求头。Docker loopback URL 转为 `host.docker.internal`，Apple Container 使用 `192.168.64.1` 的 HTTP 转发，host network 保留原地址。TB 每个 trial 只导出自己的模型并通过 Vibemon 转发选定端点。

Python 响应缓存包含模型/端点身份及请求选项，避免修改 system prompt 或 token budget 后误用旧缓存。`--report --output-dir <run>` 直接读取已保存的报告，不解析模型或发送请求。

### Slim integration, build and maintenance cost — 2026-11-19

The trim has reduced dependency and source scope substantially. Its main added
cost is maintaining a coherent downstream contract across configuration, old
sessions/extensions, test fixtures and native distribution. There is no measured
evidence here of increased runtime overhead. Fewer source lines alone establish
neither faster execution nor a better test suite.

#### Source and verification boundary

The source submitted for this build is
`ae480c973c183d9ca66fc19a25ed6a7d8546418d`, on public `NexusKMT/omp-slim/main`.
The cleanup was initially based on `e8d1f678b3`. Fetching before submission found
48 remote commits ending at `ea3ca64360`, including deletion of stats,
metaharness, Nix, telemetry, research consumers and additional tests, and the
catalog's move into `ai`.

Integration produced 86 conflicted paths, including 61 modify/delete conflicts.
The applicable cleanup was rebased onto the remote changes, preserving those
removals. The integrated cleanup changes 80 files, with 1,368 insertions and
7,813 deletions relative to `ea3ca64360`; these counts include documentation and
test data, not just implementation. The temporary Python model bridge and
benchmark config exporter were discarded along with their deleted consumers.
The shared configured-model resolver remains for the surviving TS tools.

This is a measured coordination cost of diverging checkouts during broad
deletion, not an estimate of recurring effort on every future change. The five
earlier audit/cleanup reports now explicitly identify their older source tree;
their test totals must not be attributed to this integrated source.

Local checks on the integrated tree:

- `bun install --frozen-lockfile`: passed.
- `bun run check:ts`: passed; 81 existing lint warnings remain.
- Six affected test files: 15 passed, zero failed, 45 assertions. These exercise
  configured model resolution, maintenance-tool requests, Slim configuration,
  annotation model inheritance, extension selection and CLI model deferral.
- A direct schema probe confirms that an unknown compatibility key is discarded.
  No real model endpoint or user credentials were used for this probe.

Remote workflow: [Intel macOS run 44549416311](https://github.com/NexusKMT/omp-slim/actions/runs/44549416311).
Native/standalone compilation, architecture/signature/load-path checks and worker
smoke passed in 11m39s. PTY regressions passed in 10s and `check:ts` in 18s.
The full TS gate failed: **135 of 157 command groups passed, 22 failed**, in
479.8s. These are process groups, not individual tests. Logs contain 54 failure
reports across 30 reported file paths, including a repeated imported TUI suite.
The original run is therefore **not** a fully validated release.

The audit found a concrete product regression among these failures: the minimal
default prompt stopped rendering `alwaysApplyRules`, although rules were still
loaded and supplied to the template. Thus `RULES.md` did not reach the model.
Commit `06ef50a1eac0ba28dbe5ea5b33d9438bed3bdb89` restores rendering of supplied
user customization and always-apply rules in eight template lines. It does not
restore the removed boilerplate. The malformed-template regression now checks
that user rules survive fallback, replacing its assertion of an old policy
heading. Forty existing tests across rules reload, scoped rules, template
fallback and prompt deduplication pass with 119 assertions; `check:ts` passes.

[Follow-up run 44556806308](https://github.com/NexusKMT/omp-slim/actions/runs/44556806308)
checked the native input fingerprint, reused the addon from the first run, and
packaged/verified this repaired source before repeating the TS gate. The final
result is **136 of 157 command groups passed, 21 failed**, in 530.7s: 44 failure
reports across 27 reported file paths. The three rule/scoped-session/template
test files repaired above no longer report failures. An SDK fallback test still
asserts the removed policy heading; it is listed separately among the remaining
failures. The full workflow remains failed. Reusing the matching addon avoided
another full native rebuild for a prompt-only product change.

Generated native declarations and JS exports recovered from the first run match
the tracked files byte for byte. The first archive and extracted executable
passed their SHA-256 checks locally; `--version`, `--help` and `--smoke-test`
passed with isolated config directories. The recovered addon also passed an
actual local macOS spelling check (the hosted job skips that service check).
