It was recovered under `dist/actions/44556806308/binary/`, checked against its
archive and executable SHA-256 manifests, and passed local signature,
`--version`, `--help` and worker-smoke checks with isolated configuration.
Its native provenance confirms identical build inputs and the same addon digest
as the first build. The existing installed user CLI was not replaced.

| Repaired artifact, source `06ef50a1ea` | Bytes | SHA-256 |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| `omp-darwin-x64.tar.gz` | 97,499,026 | `bc946060377ae07d2f59ee306f503067ea4c35cfa59576c8e601b2e9dac30e34` |
| Extracted `omp` | 188,638,192 | `f20bb04365112f378a8358793a2460f18a95ea0a378235baeb7dabb7704e500f` |

Native compilation itself took 626s in the
first run, CLI compilation 50s, and the remaining time in the 699s build step
covered checks and packaging. These durations are not a controlled comparison.

#### What became smaller

The comparison uses the pinned upstream baseline
`21f1188cf88b2f534c092181968cd5a4d1a9c296`, recovered from upstream and measured
directly. The local `v18.18.3` tag resolves to a different commit,
`7e8e0b8297afab0b40be28245dc4c6c44f8b5222`; its tree lacks two generated data
files present in the pinned baseline. Both revisions are included in the local
evidence, and the source/dependency rows below are identical for them.

| Measurement | Pinned `21f1188cf8` | Integrated `ae480c973c` | Change |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Bun lockfile package entries | 462 | 245 | −47.0% |
| Cargo lockfile package entries | 979 | 739 | −24.5% |
| Bun workspaces, including the root | 18 | 10 | −8 |
| JS/TS-family files under `src`, physical lines | 1,105,341 | 636,521 | −42.4% |
| Dedicated test paths, physical lines | 1,128,544 | 497,907 | −55.9% |
| Other Rust source, including inline tests, physical lines | 705,292 | 603,894 | −14.4% |
| Scripts/bench/research paths, physical lines | 79,910 | 23,705 | −70.3% |
| Recognized test fixtures/snapshots, physical lines | 79,360 | 76,144 | −4.1% |
| Documentation, physical lines | 73,839 | 50,471 | −31.6% |

These are tracked-file measurements from `git archive`, excluding installed
dependencies and build output. Classification is heuristic and mutually
exclusive: recognized vendor paths, generated/declaration paths and fixture
paths precede test/source classification. Physical lines include comments and
blank lines; generated files or vendored implementations without recognizable
paths can remain in source buckets. The dedicated-test bucket can also contain
test support data. This is not a count of handwritten product logic, executable
test cases, coverage or engineering effort.

Lockfile entries are not the set of dependencies compiled for one target. Cargo
entries increased from 737 on the earlier local tree to 739 after integration:
the retained PTY crate and Linux keyboard dependency were added while direct
Windows dependencies were removed. A smaller product does not require every
intermediate count to decrease.

#### Added costs and decisions

| Area | Evidence in the integrated source | Cost and recommended treatment |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Real behavior lost at a retained boundary | The reduced default template consumed skills but omitted loaded always-apply rules. Rule-loading code remained active, so type checks could not detect the lost output. | Highest immediate priority; fixed in `06ef50a1ea` and verified by the existing behavior tests. This is a reason to retain tests of user instructions reaching the request, even after deleting prompt-wording tests. |
| Test assumptions after catalog removal | 155 coding-agent test files reference `getBundledModel`, `getBundledModels` or `GeneratedProvider`. Their shared 37-line helper synthesizes one Chat Completions model with image input, four effort levels, zero prices and a 200k context window. | High priority for targeted review. Tests can look like they cover different suppliers while exercising the same synthetic capabilities. Replace misleading fixture assumptions with explicit capability inputs when touching the affected behavior; delete assertions for removed behavior. The reference count does **not** establish that all 155 files are useless. |
| Default-role compatibility spread | 14 production source files mention role APIs/types; `session/role-models.ts` is 50 lines and ignores its `_role` argument. Settings still exposes the default-role aliases and mirrored settings operations. | Moderate maintenance cost, little apparent algorithmic cost. Move internal callers to the canonical model API before considering removal of compatibility at extension, persisted-session or worker-message boundaries. Simply deleting the aliases can break consumers that still exist. |
| Manual endpoint capabilities | One transport remains, but image/tool support, effort mapping, context limits, pricing and wire options come from configuration. Unknown fields are silently removed. A probe with `supportsUsageInStreamng: false` retained only the correctly spelled `supportsStore` option. | Some provider-maintenance work has shifted to the endpoint operator. Configuration spelling mistakes can be harder to diagnose. The current guide now documents the actual stripping behavior; introducing diagnostics would be a separate behavior change, not a reason to restore a vendor catalog. |
| Native packaging and distribution | `scripts/slim/` plus the three active workflows total 1,713 physical lines, including benchmarking/diagnostic machinery. The fork owns target selection, toolchain/cache compatibility, native declarations, worker packaging, checksums and artifact recovery. | Recurring ownership cost. Keep the ordinary build/smoke path small; retire experiment machinery when its measurements are no longer needed. Reuse a verified addon for TS development. A full native/standalone rebuild is an integration gate, not the default feedback loop. |
| Documentation and validation drift | The model guide still referred to `packages/catalog`; it described unknown fields as errors. Root instructions still claimed retained stats and a removed SDK workflow. Earlier test reports described an older checkout. | Immediate cleanup completed in this assessment: correct live guides and label historical results by revision. Build/test reports must identify their exact source. Otherwise subsequent agents can reintroduce deleted components or trust obsolete results. |
| Surviving model-backed maintenance tools | One 37-line resolver and a two-line script re-export use the real registry, settings and authentication path. The integrated tree removes the Python bridge because its consumers are gone. | Small, localized adaptation cost. Keep the shared path while consumers exist; avoid copied endpoint/auth resolution or retaining experiments solely to justify compatibility code. |

The earlier [run 44465407429](https://github.com/NexusKMT/omp-slim/actions/runs/44465407429)
at `7bcef6f05b03fa7b7761e6c9d5eadc312cd5a7d2` illustrates the distinction between
compilation and test reconciliation: native/CLI compilation completed in 11m02s,
the PTY and TS gates passed, but 21 of 160 TS groups failed after roughly 8m13s.
Logs include tests asserting settings/discovery behavior already removed from
that source. Subsequent commits removed some of those stale cases, so these are
historical failures, not a claim that the same 21 groups fail at `ae480c973c`.

The added role wrappers and synthetic fixture helper are small in line count.
Their cost comes from how many callers still rely on old concepts. Conversely,
an old-session migration or a retained shell/session regression test can remain
valuable even if it mentions a removed supplier. Names and test age alone are
insufficient deletion criteria.

The current failure log provides concrete next-review targets:

- Clearly retired subjects include `/skills search`, `stats` argv routing,
  foreign-agent MCP discovery, `--from-claude`, the legacy environment alias and
  the removed `session_recaps` table. Mixed files still contain useful tests;
  this evidence does not justify deleting every failing file.
- Marketplace discovery now uses OMP extension roots, while a test expects
  marketplace packages to be excluded from those roots. The slash-command
  fixture also omits the runtime link and OMP manifest needed by the current
  loader. Align these tests with real installation before declaring the
  surviving marketplace contract broken.
- Tests expecting removed default policy/personality/visual guidance need a
  contract review. Rules delivery was a real regression and has been repaired;
  a missing boilerplate heading alone is not the same failure.
- Yield-report, transcript-rebuild and terminal-layout failures remain separate
  investigations. Their names do not prove they are obsolete. No claim is made
  that the remaining complete suite is green.

#### Priority after this build

1. Classify failures of the integrated remote gate by current user-visible
   behavior. Repair retained contracts; remove tests whose entire subject was
   deliberately removed. Do not suppress failures merely to obtain a green run.
2. Simplify the synthetic-model fixture contract and the tests that depend on
   its universal capability defaults. Retain representative model-resolution,
   wire, session replay, compaction, edit and shell failures, not repeated
   supplier-name rows exercising one path.
3. Reduce internal default-role plumbing while keeping any required persisted
   or external compatibility at the boundary. Measure the affected consumers
   before deleting an exported method or worker operation.
4. Keep source revisions, addon digests and completed validation together.
   Review upstream fixes selectively against the retained features; avoid
   treating a broad upstream merge or a new total-line count as verification.

No CPU, memory or request-latency regression is established by this audit.
Previous compiler experiments changed Cargo profiles and cache conditions;
their improvements must not all be credited to feature deletion. The current
build records an actual integration duration, not a controlled before/after
performance experiment. Core session/edit/shell contracts still need meaningful
tests regardless of the desired size of the test tree.

Local evidence is under `dist/validation/maintenance-cost-2026-11-19/`:
`source-counts.json`, the one-off `measure.py`, `dependencies.jsonl`,
`unknown-field-probe.json`, `check-ts.log`, `focused-tests.log`,
`rules-regressions.log`, `check-ts-rules.log`, both Actions logs/status records,
both failure lists and `local-artifact-verification.json`. These are ignored
audit artifacts, not a new permanent measurement framework. The recovered
follow-up validation artifact is in `dist/actions/44556806308/validation/`.
No OMP Slim Codespace was running at the end. The only listed Codespace belonged
to a different repository, was left alone, and reported `Shutdown` on the final check.

### Slim test cleanup — 2026-11-19

> Historical audit on the `e8d1f678b3` working tree. The later integration with

This pass removes tests that no longer exercise a supported Slim path, reduces
duplicate assertions, and keeps useful state-transition coverage runnable with
local fixtures. It changes tests and their helpers, not product behavior.

Relative to the working tree at the start of this pass:

- Ten test files removed, with two additional suites simplified and renamed.
- TypeScript tests and helpers reduced by 1,686 physical lines, including the
  replacement local navigation cases. This is a maintenance-size measurement,
  not a quality score.
- One unused endpoint helper and the unreferenced `before-compaction.jsonl`
  fixture removed. The latter is 2,367,896 bytes / 1,003 JSONL lines of test data,
  counted separately from test source. The referenced `large-session.jsonl`
  fixture remains in use by the cut-point regression.

#### Decisions and retained coverage

| Area | Evidence and change | Retained behavior |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Old live compaction, hook and RPC suites | Their `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` gates survived, but their model fixture now points at `models.example.invalid`. The RPC harness also assumes an unconfigured bundled model. Removed `agent-session-compaction`, `compaction-hooks` and `rpc.test.ts`. | Local compaction cancellation, replay-boundary and progress-guard suites; RPC durable history, thinking controls, session opening and bash-context suites. |

| Tree navigation | Replaced ten live-model cases with five local cases using the existing mock transport. | Summary attachment at root/user/assistant targets, custom instructions reaching the summarizer, journal preservation, restoration without summarization and abort without mutation. |
| Shared session helper | Removed supplier key lookup and wired scripted transports into both the main agent and side requests. An unscripted model call fails locally. | Existing startup, navigation, fork and transition tests continue to run without model service credentials. |
| Empty files and thin wrappers | Removed empty advisor/compaction files, two tests of literal `mode === "on"` decisions, and the standalone Buffer Base64 wrapper check. | Session message pipeline, prompt/tool rendering and real image resize tests cover the consuming behavior. |
| Old catalog fallback reproduction | Removed `repro-issue-1022-disabled-default-model`: its now-empty registry cannot exercise the claimed competing-provider selection. | Explicit endpoint rejection remains in `config/manual-model-resolver`; current CLI selection tests use a real configured competing endpoint. |
| Slash-containing model IDs | Folded four supplier-labelled parser/CLI cases into the manual resolver suite. | Both literal `namespace/model` and qualified `gateway/namespace/model` resolve through the CLI boundary. |

### OMP Slim 构建审核 — 2026-11-20

审核基线：`131cb27e2ff7bfe04b5dcd6d22cc58e3c51f9181`。范围是编译加速相关的
Cargo profile、native 构建入口、缓存与复用、PTY 测试边界、计时方法及既有结论。
依据包括官方文档、固定依赖的实际代码、重新恢复的 Actions 原始日志，以及本轮
固定工具链下的项目编译计划和隔离小工程实测。小工程只验证机制，不代表 OMP 性能。

#### 已确认的问题与处理

| 级别 | 问题与证据 | 处理 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| P1 | 工作区实际加载的 native 文件仍是 11 月 13 日的旧产物，版本同为 18.18.3，loader 报 `stale=false`，但仍导出 `appleFm*`、`applyBinaryPatch` 等已删除能力。当前 `verify-native.ts` 检查实际失败。 | 备份旧文件，核对 Rust 源码/锁文件及生成绑定后，原子替换为 `44549416311` 已校验的 ci 产物。替换后导出检查、源码 worker smoke 和 6 项 PTY/shell 用例通过。版本号只说明发布版本匹配，不能证明当前 checkout 的实现已加载。 |
| P1 | native 构建未锁定 Cargo 依赖。已安装的 NAPI-RS 3.7.2 先执行无 `--locked` 的 metadata；只向后续 build 传 `--locked` 仍会先改写过期的锁文件。隔离工程复现了这一行为。 | 构建入口先执行 `cargo metadata --locked`，再向 napi 的 build 转发 `--locked`。真实入口的隔离验证确认：过期锁文件被拒绝且字节不变；有效锁文件继续进入 build，锁定及计时参数都到达 Cargo。 |
| P1 | OMP 工具命令的环境注入 `CI=true`；当前 Cargo 因而默认禁用增量编译。工作流补过开关，原日常开发命令却未补。用实际 `buildNonInteractiveEnv()` 输出环境启动当前项目的 unit graph，三个主要 crate 均为 `incremental=false`。 | 文档中的 Rust 开发命令显式设置 `CARGO_INCREMENTAL=1`，并说明作用域。没有给整个产品 shell 强加 Rust 专用开关。 |
| P2 | development benchmark 把预热后的第二次调用直接记作 unchanged；NAPI typedef 缓存创建后，force-build 环境变化仍可能使其重编。compiler matrix 虽有 settle，但也未拒绝非零编译单元。 | 两个入口均在稳定后要求 unchanged 的编译单元数为零，否则停止采样。隔离 Cargo 工程验证了环境变化重编 2 单元时拒绝、稳定后 0 单元通过、真实编辑后输出改变。本轮未修改基线的完整远程运行随后也复现：标记为 unchanged 的调用仍编译了 pi-natives。 |
| P2 | 上游例子的 `196 MB → 130 MB`、`131 MB → 214 MB` 和“sccache 实测更慢”被保留在 AGENTS 中，甚至禁止再次评估。`git log -S` 将它们追到上游 `ce1d1fee68`，未找到对应 Slim 原始实测。 | 移除无项目证据的数字与禁止评估措辞，保留已核实的机制和约束。metadata 小工程确认固定工具链接受该选项且减少 rlib 内完整元数据的重复；没有将其宣称为整项目提速。 |
| P2 | “dev 是默认”“profiling 与生产只有体积不同”省略了入口差异。`build:native` 实际默认 O3/ThinLTO `local`，交付脚本用 O3/LTO off `ci`；profiling 继承 fat-LTO release。 | 修正文档和注释；没有在缺少运行性能证据时更换默认 profile。 |
| P2 | 文档漏记 11 月 18 日已成功的增量实测，SLIM 仍把“修正后尚未重跑”当成当前状态。沿缓存 key 查到源码 `f5f4e6dcdb` 及运行 `44300999380`，原始日志确认采样和最终校验成功。 | 补回该运行、单样本结果及旧 LTO 条件；撤回“修正后从未实测”的说法。历史报告按写作日期保留限制，附后续更新。 |

P1 表示会改变依赖来源或日常反馈行为的缺口；P2 表示实验可信度和维护决策的缺口。

此前 `44549416311` 保存的构建后源码状态为空，没有显示这一问题曾在该次构建触发。

#### 规范与实际参数

工具链为 `rustc 1.102.0-nightly f5cedb83a`、Cargo `c07ac2c4d`，固定日期
`nightly-2026-11-08`；本机为 macOS Intel，Bun 1.4.4。当前项目只读执行：

```sh
cargo build --offline --locked -p pi-natives --profile dev \
  --target x86_64-apple-darwin --unit-graph -Z unstable-options
```

| 环境 / profile | pi-natives / pi-builtins 优化级别 | pi-shell 优化级别 | LTO | 三者 incremental |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 无 CI，dev | 0 | 1 | off | true |
| CI=true，dev | 0 | 1 | off | false |
| CI=true、CARGO_INCREMENTAL=1，dev | 0 | 1 | off | true |
| CI=true，local | 3 | 3 | thin | false |
| CI=true，ci | 3 | 3 | off | false |

Cargo 文档明确说明 `CI` 下的增量默认值、环境变量覆盖顺序，以及 `lto=false`
仍允许 crate 内 ThinLTO，`"off"` 才完全关闭。配置含有 `incremental=true`
不能替代实际编译计划；恢复 Actions 缓存也不能证明 Cargo 单元保持 Fresh。
[Cargo incremental](https://doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/reference/config.html#buildincremental)、
[Cargo profiles](https://doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/reference/profiles.html#lto)。

NAPI 官方文档支持通过 `--` 传 Cargo 参数，但已安装 CLI 的 metadata 调用在
转发 build 参数之前。前置检查因此有必要；单独给 build 加锁不足以覆盖前一步。
[Cargo metadata --locked](https://doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/commands/cargo-metadata.html#manifest-options)、
[NAPI build](https://napi.rs/docs/cli/build#passing-flags-to-cargo)。

`embed-metadata=false` 的微型 lib/consumer 工程中，rlib 为 5648 / 3504 字节，
其中 `lib.rmeta` 成员为 2608 / 464 字节；两种构建的消费者均输出 42。
关闭嵌入后仍有元数据占位/链接信息，不能根据成员名仍存在就断言选项无效。
这验证了机制，不提供 Slim 整体体积或耗时收益。
[Cargo embed-metadata](https://doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/reference/unstable.html#embed-metadata)。

sccache 官方文档确认不能缓存 incremental crate 及调用系统链接器的
cdylib/bin/proc-macro；这个限制支持暂不把它作为最终 addon 加速方案，不能证明
本项目使用它一定更慢。[sccache Rust 支持](https://github.com/mozilla/sccache/blob/main/docs/Rust.md)。

#### 哪些旧结论有证据，哪些仍不能推广

重新下载了 [43947005367](https://github.com/NexusKMT/omp-slim/actions/runs/43947005367)
的原始日志和状态，确认三个配置作业成功。native 单元预热后：

| 配置 | Cargo 自报编译秒数 | 包含 NAPI 构建/安装的墙钟秒数 |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| O3 ThinLTO | 603 | 606 |
| O3 LTO off | 166 | 171 |
| O2 LTO off | 120 | 124 |

因此 O3 关闭 LTO 的方向有项目证据，但每种配置只有一次这类重编样本，且是旧源码、
无 rustc incremental、修改时间戳的实验。72.5% 对应 Cargo 编译部分，不能套到
冷启动、跨 job 缓存恢复、完整交付，或当前真实编辑循环上。

PTY 拆分也有直接依据：当前 native 的 unit graph 为 763 个单元、555 个不同包 ID；
独立 PTY test 图为 10 个单元、8 个不同包 ID，其中含 doctest 单元。它们不是同一种
数量口径。`pi-natives` 调用 `pi_pty::await_output_drain`，没有另存测试专用实现。
本轮 `CARGO_INCREMENTAL=1 bun run test:rs --package pi-pty` 的 7 项测试通过。
这证明定向测试边界有效，不意味着整个 addon 构建降到几秒。

旧的 dev/local 比较和 27 次前端矩阵记录仍有效，但当时 incremental 实际关闭，
dev 的 LTO 也与当前不同。它们用于定位旧配置的瓶颈，不能作为当前 dev 的验收。
不过，11 月 18 日的 [44300999380](https://github.com/NexusKMT/omp-slim/actions/runs/44300999380)
已经启用 incremental：一次 native 编辑构建/安装为 26.125s，Cargo 为 23.040s，
行为验证与 worker smoke 完成为 29.530s；稳定无修改构建 5.638s、0 单元。
源码恢复和 PTY、shell、grammar 校验均通过。其 `dev lto=false` 与当前 `"off"`
不同；这仍不是对当前配置的三次重复测量。
提高 jobs、关闭 WASM、checksum freshness 均缺少当前配置下可归因的完整反馈时间对照；
其中关闭 WASM 有依赖图和体积证据，不能据此补推编译提速。

#### 开发配置的运行成本

在同一本机 Intel Core m3-8100Y（2 核/4 线程、16 GiB RAM）、Bun 1.4.4 上
直接加载有已核对 SHA-256 的两个插件，
顺序为 ci/dev、dev/ci、ci/dev；每次启动新进程，预热后测三个批次，共每配置
每负载 9 个批次。固定输入和输出校验相同，排除把错误结果当作更快。
ci 来自 `44549416311`，dev 来自本轮 `44562078213`；两者 Rust 源码与锁文件
相同，profile 不同。整个 profile 同时改变优化、符号和检查选项，不归因于单一参数。

| 固定工作负载 | ci 中位数 ms/次 | dev 中位数 ms/次 | dev/ci |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| ANSI/Unicode 文本宽度（256 次重复文本） | 0.0832 | 0.8945 | 10.76 |
| O200k token 计数（128 次重复段落） | 0.1214 | 2.2786 | 18.77 |
| 保留 Shell 实例，100 次算术循环 | 0.8382 | 1.1634 | 1.39 |

宽度、token 数、shell 输出分别稳定为 5632、2048、4950。每批次数分别为
200、20、5。完整输入、执行脚本和每批次数据保存于 `runtime-probe.mjs`、
`compare-runtime.py`、`runtime-comparison.json`；关键结果也进入审核数据 JSON。
小 shell 用例的绝对耗时很短、波动较大；这三项不是完整交互性能评测，更不能把
18.77 倍推广到整个 CLI。但足以否定“编译更快而运行几乎无代价”的假设。

当前处理：保留 ci 作为交付/本地使用的已验证插件；dev 用于显式的 Rust 修改验证。
没有因编辑耗时缩短就替换默认构建 profile。本轮 dev 插件只保存在证据目录。

### OMP Slim scope cleanup — 2026-11-20

Baseline: `7237061f7925fce5475907cd53dd5c3337a9f96b`. This pass implements the
requested removal of the unrelated features found in the scope audit. Core
sessions, editing, shell, task subagents, MCP, HTTP search and manual instructions
remain the supported workflow.

#### Removed

- Auto-QA, grievances, report_issue, their consent/UI/CLI paths and spool helpers.
- Advisors, Vibe, Autoresearch and built-in personality presets, including tools,
  prompts, settings, registry/UI/RPC integration and feature-specific tests.
- Claude and Jev tokenizer reconstructions, vocabulary data, packers and fixtures.
- Retired provider error classes and subscription/protocol-specific retry branches,
  including Google RPC quota parsing. Generic HTTP status, transport, token-budget,
  quota and schema errors remain supported for configured Chat Completions endpoints.
- The production test-model fallback and catalog-shaped test helper. Model tests
  now construct synthetic fixtures with explicit capabilities.
- Internal model-role APIs and mirror operations. Selection uses `getModel` /
  `setModel`; old main-model selectors and saved session entries remain readable at
  input/migration boundaries. Other model roles cannot enable routing.
- Session analysis/research scripts, upstream publishing scripts, publish-only
  configuration, release tests/commands and archived upstream workflows.

The user-interrupt auto-resume latch now belongs to AgentSession itself, because
IRC and queued messages still need it after Advisor removal. Retired passive
review transcripts are excluded from subagent discovery so reopening an old
session cannot turn a review transcript into an executable task.

Configuration approval, credential masking and panel-clear tests use explicit,
per-test fixture handles. They do not register fake settings in the production
registry. Tests of removed features were deleted; assertions for retained
behavior were adapted. No coverage or test-count target was introduced.

#### Remote validation of `8732977f31`

The removal code was committed as
`8732977f3157cec9dfdb1b32848cfa0bb216ab09`. Initial local TypeScript and
formatting checks passed; two focused runs covered 256 tests across 16 files
with zero failures. Those initial results did not replace the full integration
gate.

| Validation | Recorded result |
| --- | --- |
| Intel macOS build [44661615938](https://github.com/NexusKMT/omp-slim/actions/runs/44661615938) | Native addon and standalone CLI compilation, worker smoke, PTY checks and TypeScript checks passed. The retained TypeScript gate passed **140 of 153 test command groups**, with **13 failed groups**, in 450.7s; the workflow therefore failed. |
| Rust [44661621941](https://github.com/NexusKMT/omp-slim/actions/runs/44661621941) | Rust checks and nextest completed: **6,200 passed, 52 skipped**. The doctests that ran also passed; ignored or unsupported doctests are not counted as executed coverage. |
| Native development feedback [44661628186](https://github.com/NexusKMT/omp-slim/actions/runs/44661628186) | The unchanged build took **2.677s and compiled zero units**. Three native edits took **12.171 / 12.590 / 10.149s** from edit through behavior verification and source worker smoke (median **12.171s**); each rebuilt one native unit. |

The 153 TypeScript entries are test-command groups, not individual tests. The
failed groups included retired provider/Advisor expectations and model-fixture
drift, as well as regressions in anonymized model metadata and historical
subagent attribution. The subsequent local fixes are separate from the
committed source and remote results above. The earlier 157/157 green run
validated `f37c6d4688`, before this removal pass.

The development samples changed one native function body in a single retained
checkout and target directory. They exclude initial warm-up, runner startup
and cross-job cache restoration, and do not measure shell/builtins edits or
runtime performance parity. Different runner runs cannot establish how much of
the time difference was caused by source removal. The audited scripts require
a stable unchanged build with zero compiled units before accepting edit
samples; deletion counts alone do not establish a speed improvement.

Original results remain under `dist/actions/44661615938/`,
`dist/actions/44661621941/rust/` and
`dist/actions/44661628186/benchmark/`. The native edit samples and cache
provenance are in the latter directory's
`omp-slim/omp-slim/dist/validation/development-benchmark/dev/summary.json` and
`provenance.json`.

#### Final retained TypeScript gate

The full gate needed two environment corrections before the final run. The
initial run kept the caller's existing home/config state and failed 17 of 153
test-command groups, including tests that observed that state. The next run
isolated home and config under the checkout, but that long path caused the
task-progress path-shortening expectation to fail in one group. These were
environment setup results, not evidence that the source patch had passed the
full gate.

The final environment used a short home at `/tmp/omp-home`, isolated OMP state,
the real Bun, uv, and CPython executables on `PATH`, offline/no-sync Python,
downloads disabled, and concurrency 2. The first full run in this corrected
environment had one failed group: the fake-server handshake case in
`packages/coding-agent/test/tools/ovnfs-search.test.ts` emitted `write EPIPE`.
The focused case passed in 3 standalone runs, and the complete 10-test file
passed in 5 runs; the subsequent full-gate confirmation under the same corrected
environment passed **153 of 153 test-command groups, with 0 failed, in 820.2s**.
These are command-group counts, not individual test-case counts. The earlier
`EPIPE` happened once and was not reproduced; that does not rule out future
intermittency. Triage favors a test-harness socket race with moderate
confidence, not a proven cause. See `dist/validation/scope-reconciliation-2026-11-20/full-gate-final-result.json`,
`full-gate-confirmation-result.json`, and `ovnfs-triage.json` with their logs.

The final checked-out `HEAD` remains `8732977f3157cec9dfdb1b32848cfa0bb216ab09`.
The follow-up code and documentation changes remain uncommitted in the working
tree; no commit, reset, or push was made as part of this closeout. The older Rust
workflow result above remains **6,200 passed, 52 skipped**, with the doctests
that executed passing; it was not rerun locally as part of this final TypeScript
confirmation.

After the final gate, `bun run check:ts` passed again after correcting two stale
discovery comments; those comment-only edits do not alter runtime behavior.
With AppleSpell enabled, `packages/natives/test/native.test.ts` passed
**60, skipped 1, failed 0**. Final `git diff --check` passed. The check logs and
machine-readable results are under
`dist/validation/scope-reconciliation-2026-11-20/`.

| 退出的 stats、skills search、changelog、recap、旧环境变量 | 删除独占用例或替换失效输入 | 用 `gc` 验证 CLI 路由，用 plugins 验证子命令补全；保留 SQLite 损坏恢复中的提示和标题数据保障 |
| 默认提示词和欢迎文本已经精简 | 移除旧标题/措辞断言，改用用户规则、显式模板或固定页头 | 自定义模板回退、PERSONALITY.md 覆盖、security URL 条件暴露、图像工具的文件写入限制、滚动后编辑器位置 |
| 插件安装测试仍假定 marketplace 包不会进入 OMP loader | 按现有原生安装和加载约定修正预期，补齐插件 manifest 与运行时链接 | 安装后发现、启用、禁用和项目作用域行为 |

#### 测试揭示的真实问题

##### 最终 assistant 消息与工具执行竞态

`sdk-yield-report` 的两个用例和 issue #12247 的会话重建用例在修改前均能本地复现：
流生产者已经发布 `message_end` 并继续执行工具，消费端却还没有把最终 assistant
消息写入 Agent 状态或 SessionManager。表现为 `yield` 找不到报告文本，或重建上下文
漏掉正在执行的 tool call。

Agent 现在在最终 `message_end` 已交付状态和同步订阅者后释放正式工具派发边界；
AgentSession 再等待现有的消息持久化队列。等待不包含异步通知监听器，也没有用
`sleep` 猜测事件时序。事件消费者退出时会释放交付等待。参数预处理和工具参数修订
仍先于最终消息发布，因此这里没有改变审批/参数修订的时序。
已有的推测读取仍可提前执行；本次针对的是最终消息之后的正式派发和结果提交。

正常最终事件和仅通过 `result()` 返回最终消息的路径都应用这一边界。保留原有
yield、会话重建、延迟通知、暂停、取消和推测执行回归测试，仅给已有 yield 用例表
增加一项零事件流输入，覆盖不同的最终消息处理分支。

##### 精简模板遗漏动态能力数据

开启 `inlineToolDescriptors` 时，工具描述会从 API 工具定义中移到提示词；精简模板
原先没有渲染已经生成的 `toolInventory`，于是两处都没有描述。模板现已条件渲染该
数据，现有异步 task 工具指引测试和动态工具启停测试均通过。

技能列表现在输出具体的 `skill://<name>` 地址，让保留的技能 reader 可以被找到。
没有恢复已删除的通用行为口号或默认 personality 段落。

生产代码净增加 35 行，包括显式交付确认、持久化回调以及模板数据恢复。
消息队列和持久化实现沿用现有机制，没有新增轮询、固定延时或存储层。
这是修复可复现行为所需的成本，尚未单独测量其性能开销。
本轮也没有证明所有剩余测试都值得保留：审查范围是完整 gate 中的已知失败、
相关退出功能及此次修复影响到的保留行为，不以用例数或覆盖率作为质量结论。
